nodes.title: Box wall stack 12.5 mm per side along the chord
nodes.text: The transport box loses 12.5 mm per side along the chord: 4 mm corrugated shell at both ends plus the 1/2 in PE nose pad (D7-R4 stack after D-62: 4 + 4 + 12.7 = 20.7 mm over two sides); the span and height faces lose 4 mm plus the cradle and pillar preloads, less than this
nodes.basis: D7 CL-D7-NOSE-GAP (12.95 mm at the 0.498 m envelope with a 3/4 in pad); D-62 moves the nose 10 mm and the pad goes to 1/2 in (CR-A1-66). Was 25 mm (R0 guess: 1/4 in ply + 18 mm foam)

nodes.title: Pack station A3's current roll-up carries

reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Pack masses the frame checks (D-64)
nodes.text: Lightest and heaviest flight pack the CG and gate checks run with: the Ovonic 120C EC5 listing minus its tolerance (546 g) and the acceptance line A1 set in D-64 (590 g; CALC-A1-PACK-ACCEPT gives the exact figure from A3's gate margin)
nodes.basis: E2 CR-E2-24: listing 551 +/- 5 g. D-64 retires the 503 / 680 g bounding listings of D-58/D-59 as flight cases; A3 updates ASM-A3-PACK-RANGE to the same pair

nodes.title: Flying mass added by the R5 decisions, not yet in A3's roll-up (retired: 0 g)
nodes.text: C3's pod fixes, the D-62 nose shell, C6's pins and collar, D3's sealing bead and C5's shoe fix are all in the delivered parts lists A3 rolls up (D2-R6/R7, D3-R5, D5-R7), so nothing is added on top: 0 g
nodes.basis: D-63 set it to 21.4 g until D2, D3 and D5 published; D-95 (2026-11-13) sets it to 0 because they have (A3 roll-up: pod 145.4, fins 433.3, landing 59.1 g). This is what made A1's acceptance line (571.5 g) differ from A3's (592.9 g): one number now, CL-A3-PACK-ACCEPT

nodes.title: NXP UM10204 I2C-bus specification and user manual, Rev. 7.0 (1 Oct 2021)
nodes.where: Table 10 (p. 43): Ci <= 10 pF per I/O pin, VOL 0.4 V at IOL 3 mA; Table 11 (p. 44): Fast-mode Cb <= 400 pF, tr <= 300 ns (Standard-mode 1000 ns); section 7.1 (p. 50): rise 0.3-0.7 VDD = 0.8473 R C, so Rp(max) = tr / (0.8473 Cb), Rp(min) = (VDD - VOL) / IOL; section 7.2.4 (p. 52) worked example 1.7 kOhm holds about 200 pF at 300 ns

nodes.title: 3M 3365 series 0.050 in flat cable, 28 AWG, technical data TS-0080-B
nodes.where: Electrical properties, p. 1: capacitance between adjacent conductors 8.14 pF/ft balanced (26.7 pF/m), 14.47 pF/ft unbalanced ground-signal-ground (47.5 pF/m)

nodes.title: ArduPilot Plane docs, common cabling guide, I2C section
nodes.where: I2C: keep cables short, twist SCL with +5 V and SDA with GND (about 10 turns per 30 cm); pull-ups are essential; no numeric length limit given

nodes.title: I2C bus electrical model (Fast-mode, 3.3 V)
nodes.text: Cb = L c_wire + n_pin Ci + n_board c_board. c_wire 95 pF/m EST (2 x the 3M 3365 28 AWG unbalanced 47.5 pF/m: loose silicone leads in a bundle are not a controlled flat cable); n_pin 4 (FC MCU, SPL06 baro, QMC5883L compass on the GPS, MS4525DO) at the UM10204 maximum Ci 10 pF; n_board 3 (FC, GPS, airspeed board) at 15 pF EST each for traces and the GH plug. Design budget 200 pF = half the 400 pF Fast-mode limit (UM10204's own 1.7 kOhm example holds about 200 pF at 300 ns); VDD 3.3 V
nodes.basis: UM10204 Tables 10-11 and section 7; 3M 3365 TS-0080-B; F3 ASM-F3-I2C-MAP (three devices on I2C1). Board pull-up values are not published (FC, GPS, MS4525DO: unknown); T-F3-I2C-SCAN measures them
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Wing area and aspect ratio
nodes.equation: S = b c ; AR = b^2 / S

nodes.title: Elevon area fraction
nodes.equation: A = 2 (span_in + span_out) f c ; frac = A / S

nodes.title: Prop clearances
nodes.equation: gap_vert = 2 z_m - D ; gap_lat = 2 y_m - D ; gap_tip = b/2 - y_m - D/2 ; gap_tube = (x_mount - r_tube) - x_prop ; gap_wing = z_m - D/2 - t_c c / 2 ; min of the five

nodes.title: Stance tip-over angles toward the pod side (narrow axis) and the wing tip
nodes.equation: h = c - x_cg + foot ; narrow = atan((z_pad - z_cg) / h) ; wide = atan(y_fin / h) ; corner bound at x_cg = x_range[0], z_cg = z_range[1]; target at x_target, z_cg = z_target_a3

nodes.title: Box fit
nodes.equation: internal = external - 2 wall ; slack = internal - envelope (sorted largest first)

nodes.title: params cg range sits inside B3's V1 claims (CG height included) and holds the target
nodes.equation: fwd_ok = x_range[0] - x_fwd ; aft_ok = x_aft - x_range[1] ; width = x_range[1] - x_range[0] ; target_fwd = x_t - x_range[0] ; target_aft = x_range[1] - x_t ; sm_aft = (x_np - x_range[1]) / c - sm_min

nodes.title: CG per weighed pack at its D-60 flight station in the D-62 bay
nodes.equation: x_cg = CL-A3-CG-X * c + dx_stack ; dx = CL-A3-CG-X-PRED - CL-A3-CG-X * c ; M_e x_e = M x_cg - m_p x_a3 (A3 rolls the carried pack at x_a3) ; x_fwd = x_pod_le + nose + L/2 ; x_aft = x_nom + aft_travel ; g(m) = dx M / (M_e + m) ; x_p(m) = x_aft - k step, k >= 0 the whole step that puts the mid of basic and predicted CG, x_cg(m) + g(m)/2, nearest x_t, x_p >= x_fwd ; x_cg(m) = (M_e x_e + m x_p) / (M_e + m) ; x_pred = x_cg + g(m) ; fwd margin = min x_cg - x_range[0] ; aft margin = x_range[1] - max x_pred ; ballast(nose) = (M_e + m) excess / (x_pred - x_pod_le)

nodes.title: Heaviest flight pack the first-build overrun still covers (D-64 acceptance line)
nodes.equation: accept = m_pack + gate_margin - overrun - added ; margin_sku = accept - (sku_min + 10)

nodes.title: Sized mass and A1 reserve from the allocations
nodes.equation: alloc = sum(allocations) ; sized = alloc + growth_allowance + build_overrun ; reserve_cover = growth_reserve - (growth_allowance + build_overrun) ; gate_check = gate - alloc - growth_reserve

nodes.title: Growth allowance against A3's growth by maturity
nodes.equation: growth_a3 = m_predicted - m_basic ; spare = growth_allowance - growth_a3

nodes.title: I2C bus capacitance, longest bus the budget allows, pull-up window (D-99)
nodes.equation: Cb = L c_wire + n_pin Ci + n_board c_board ; L_max = (Cb_budget - n_pin Ci - n_board c_board) / c_wire ; Rp_max = tr / (0.8473 Cb) ; Rp_min = (VDD - VOL) / IOL

nodes.title: Hover T/W at the gate and sized mass
nodes.equation: T/W = n T_max / m ; sag case x voltage_sag ; DL = m g / (n pi D^2/4)

nodes.title: Stall and transition speed at the gate
nodes.equation: Vs = sqrt(2 m g / (rho S CLmax_trimmed)) ; Vt = k Vs

nodes.title: Budget reserve, pessimistic
nodes.equation: reserve = budget - spend_pess

nodes.title: 8 m/s gust survive-and-land

nodes.title: Spiral mode

nodes.text: (a) Fin stations: the first bending and torsion natural frequencies of each motor tube + through-core block + half-fins + mount assembly with motors fitted lie outside +/-0.2 of 1P at hover rpm and of 2P (blade pass) at hover and cruise rpm; the operating points are the criterion of record and B4's 80-330 Hz whole-band rule is advisory (CR-C4-06); C4's CL-C4-D3-SEP on the two-layer fin (D-26) supersedes CL-J1-TUBE-MODE-SEP, and the 3-D solid FE of the as-designed station (CL-C4-SIM-SEP 0.29: lower station 255.5 Hz against 2P cruise 198.2 Hz at 5 946 rpm with the 84.2 g motor) is the value of record; re-run triggers (D-70, CR-C4-39): C4 re-runs the station model when the cruise rpm (CL-B4-CRUISE-RPM) exceeds 6 390 rpm or a station's mass grows more than 15 % above the as-designed 84.2 g motor + 7.6 g ESC + 4 g bullets. (b) Wing modes: the station-participating wing modes (antisymmetric torsion 12-15 Hz, in-plane ~215 Hz) cannot clear the same windows with any spar from 16 to 25 mm (CL-C2-WING-MODE-SEP, D-45), so they are closed by the tap-test branch: the tap test of the finished wing with motors fitted (T-C2-TAP-TEST) shows each such mode either damped or inside the rpm-tracking harmonic notch (F4 INS_HNTCH_* on ESC rpm, CL-F4-NOTCH-LOW, covering 1P and 2P over the rpm range), the rate-loop crossover stays <= 5 Hz, and B3 carries the 12-15 Hz antisymmetric torsion mode in the hover loop model. (c) The flight-controller vibration (ArduPilot VIBE) stays < 30 m/s2 in hover with Clip = 0

nodes.title: Per-pack flight station rule (D-98 mid-band; was D-59)
nodes.text: Each weighed pack flies at the whole spacer step (P:pod.pack_spacer_step_m), counted forward from the no-spacer station (nominal + P:pod.pack_aft_travel_m), that minimises the worse range use of the basic and the predicted CG (centres the basic-to-predicted band in cg.x_range_m), never ahead of the crush stack (ASM-A3-NOSE-STACK). After T-A3-CG-BALANCE the measured CG replaces both and the step nearest cg.x_target_m is flown
nodes.basis: params/CHANGE-LOG.md D-98 (H8: A1's mid-band rule; D-59 put the basic CG on target and left the growth on the aft side), CR-A1-53

nodes.title: Mass roll-up against allocations and the gate
nodes.equation: basic = sum m_i ; predicted = sum m_i (1 + MGA_i) ; margin = gate - predicted ; margin(pack m) = gate - (predicted - m_pack,carried + m) ; overrun_s = basic_s - alloc_s ; accept = m_pack,carried + margin - overrun

nodes.title: CG cases, pack station for the target, hover trim split
nodes.equation: cg = sum m_i r_i / sum m_i ; x_pack_req = (x_t M - (M x_cg - m_p x_p)) / m_p ; split = (z_m + z_cg) / (z_m - z_cg) ; h_stance = c - x_cg + foot ; fwd_room = (x_pack - L_pack/2) - x_pod_le - nose_stack ; range_use = |x - mid| / half-range ; shift_req(group) = (x_t - x_cg) M / m_group ; trim(pack m) = slide that brings x_cg(m) into range

nodes.title: Inertia tensor about the CG (aircraft frame)
nodes.equation: I = sum m_i (|r_i|^2 E - r_i r_i^T) + box self-inertia m/12 (b^2 + c^2) ; r_i from the CG

nodes.title: Group masses, centroids and own inertias for the loads model (CR-C1-33)
nodes.equation: per group g (and per station within g): m_g = sum m_i ; r_g = sum m_i r_i / m_g ; I_g = sum m_i (|r_i - r_g|^2 E - (r_i - r_g)(r_i - r_g)^T) + boxes ; closure: sum_g [I_g + m_g (|d_g|^2 E - d_g d_g^T)] = I_aircraft, d_g = r_g - r_cg

nodes.title: Minimum foam over the spar
nodes.text: Hot-wired XPS must keep at least 2 mm of foam between the spar tube and the skin on both surfaces
nodes.basis: A5 modelling standard: thinner foam tears when the slot is cut and the tube bonded; G2 confirms on a test core

nodes.title: Minimum elevon end gap
nodes.text: Each elevon panel end stays at least 10 mm from the pod side, the fin face and the wing tip
nodes.basis: A5 modelling standard: room for tape, a horn and +/-25 deg travel without rubbing; D6 confirms

nodes.title: Allocation split and lump stations used for the layout CG (R3 skeleton)
nodes.text: Within each allocation: wing = spar (mass/m x length); the rest split between core and elevon panels with the tape skin by planform area and foam/fill/consumables by section volume; fins = 2 tubes (spar mass/m x tube length) + per station mount 11.0, station collar 10.6, CF brace 5.2, anchor 3.2 g + 2 x 41.0 g through-core blocks (D3 R3 CAD unit masses, rounded) and 4 half-fins carrying the rest (board, edge strips, pins, ESC pad, plug share); propulsion = 4 x prop (params) at the prop plane + rest (motor, ESC, adapter, nut) as the motor envelope from DP-MOTOR-FACE; power = pack at the D-47 bay datum (D2's aft face less half the pack length) + rest at the pod nose; pod and avionics in the pod; mechanisms 23.5 mm ahead of the hinge; harness as two bundle legs (channel 14 mm aft of the spar surface, tube inboard face); feet from 12 mm ahead of the TE to DP-GROUND; printed walls 3 mm; growth reserve not placed
nodes.basis: params.json#mass.allocation_g (CHANGE-LOG D-38) and subsystems/fins/parts.csv (D3 R3); the skeleton modules (redesign/fusion/skeleton/*/fusion) use the same numbers
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Elevon hinge line
nodes.equation: x_h = c (1 - f) ; z_h = upper surface at x_h/c ; t_h = section thickness at the hinge

nodes.title: Foam cover over the spar
nodes.equation: cover_up = z_upper(x_s) - (z_s + r) ; cover_lo = (z_s - r) - z_lower(x_s) ; z_camber = (z_upper + z_lower)/2 ; cover_on_camber = (t(x_s) - 2r)/2

nodes.title: Elevon end gaps
nodes.equation: pod = distance between the inboard panel (x >= x_h, y >= y_in0) and the pod box (x <= x_pod + L, |y| <= w_pod/2) = hypot(max(0, x_h - x_pod_end), max(0, y_in0 - w_pod/2)) ; fin_in = (y_fin - t_fin/2) - y_in1 ; fin_out = y_out0 - (y_fin + t_fin/2) ; tip = b/2 - y_out1 ; t_fin = layers t_board ; x_h = c (1 - f)

nodes.title: Layout CG: allocations at the R3 datum stations
nodes.equation: x_cg = sum(m_i x_i) / sum(m_i), z likewise (lump centroids from the k09kit geometry); pack x for x_target = x_pack + M (x_target - x_cg) / m_pack ; range use = |x_cg - mid| / half range ; hover split upper/lower = (z_m + z_cg) / (z_m - z_cg)

nodes.title: APC PER3 11x5.5MR rows as copied by B4
nodes.where: team/B4/data/apc_per3_11x55MR.csv, rows rpm = 6000 (19 rows, J 0 to 0.624)
nodes.note: B1 compared every 6 000 rpm row of B4's file with PROP_TABLE on 2026-11-09. APC's blade-element prediction, not a test; B4 owns the prop data

nodes.title: 11x5.5MR Ct and Cp versus J
nodes.text: The fitted prop (APC 11x5.5MR, params propulsion.prop) follows APC's PER3 Ct(J), Cp(J) at 6 000 rpm at every operating point; rows are [J, Ct, Cp]; last row extrapolated to zero thrust
nodes.basis: B4's copy of the APC file; cruise runs at 6 000 rpm (CL-B4-CRUISE-RPM); Re effect between the 5 000 and 7 000 rpm blocks < 1 % on Ct, Cp; the hover-table calibration (CALC-B1-PROPCAL) absorbs APC's static optimism

nodes.title: 11x4.5MR Ct and Cp versus J (calibration reference)
nodes.text: APC PER3 11x4.5MR at 6 000 rpm, rows [J, Ct, Cp]; used only to calibrate the chain to the maker table (11x4.7) and for the 11x5.5MR / 11x4.5MR hover power ratio
nodes.basis: APC data file read 2026-11-09 (rev 1 of this script); the 11x4.5MR is closer in pitch to the maker's 11x4.7 than the 11x5.5MR, so it carries the calibration with less prop error

nodes.title: Zero-lift drag build-up coefficients, non-wing parts
nodes.text: [Cf fin/pod, FF fin, CD motor tube (frontal, faired by the fin), CdA per motor m2, FF pod, interference factor] = [0.0070, 1.20, 0.30, 0.0004, 1.30, 1.15]
nodes.basis: Same coefficients as the K09 card and the K01 card, accepted by the K09 REVIEW (section 4: 'already pessimistic'); turbulent flat plate at Re 3e5 for the paper-faced board and pod; Hoerner for the tube. The wing now uses B2's S5010 section drag (ASM-B1-WING-ROUGH)
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Tape-seam factor on the S5010 wing profile drag
nodes.text: The packing-tape wing has 1.10 x the XFOIL Ncrit 9 profile drag that B2's AVL polar carries
nodes.basis: B2 CR-B2-08: S5010 cd at cl 0.47 is 0.0087 (Re 3e5, Ncrit 9) and 0.0096 (Re 2.3e5, Ncrit 5); the ratio 1.10 stands in for early transition at spanwise tape seams. A trip-strip XFOIL run (B2) or the cruise-power test replaces it

nodes.title: Fin brace and station-collar drag
nodes.text: [n braces, brace length m, brace width across the flow m, brace Cd, n collars, collar OD m, collar height m, collar Cd] = [4, 0.15, 0.003, 0.80, 4, 0.026, 0.012, 0.70]; each collar replaces a 12 mm length of faired motor tube (tube Cd from ASM-B1-DRAG is subtracted)
nodes.basis: D3 CR-D3-15 geometry (braces 10 x 3 mm CF strip, 3 mm across the cruise flow, 4 x 0.15 m; collars 26 x 12 mm at |z| 0.148-0.160). Brace: sharp-edged rectangular section l/h 3.3, 2-D Cd ~0.9 (Hoerner ch. 3), x 0.9 for finite length -> 0.80, 0.23 N at 16 m/s, the top of C4's 0.07-0.24 N (CR-C4-08). Collar: short cylinder l/d 0.46 in cross-flow, Cd 0.70 (Hoerner finite cylinder). Slipstream over the braces ignored (cruise thrust per prop < 1 N). ESC pads sit in the existing per-motor CdA

nodes.title: Pressure drag of the pod widening (D-25)
nodes.text: [Cd on the added frontal area, reference pod width m] = [0.20, 0.10]: the 0.14 m pod carries Cd 0.20 on the frontal area (w - 0.10) x h on top of its friction drag in ASM-B1-DRAG
nodes.basis: D-25 (D2 CR-D2-01): +0.0028 m2 frontal, estimated +3 % cruise drag. The friction build-up (Cf FF Swet) of rev 2 was accepted for the 0.10 m pod; the extra 20 mm side channels are blunt-sided box ahead of the wing LE (fineness ~1.5 on 0.14 m), so a forebody/base pressure term is added: Cd 0.20, rounded-edge block of fineness 2-3 (Hoerner ch. 3). With the friction growth the pod adds 0.14 N at 16 m/s (3.4 % of the rev 3 cruise drag) against D-25's 3 % estimate

nodes.title: Pack terminal voltage at full throttle
nodes.text: [fresh, worst state] = [16.0, 13.6] V at the ESC input under full-throttle load
nodes.basis: fresh: 16.8 V full charge less ~0.8 V at 60-100 A on the 6.5 Ah 130C pack; worst state: E2's 20 % charge, 10 degC, 27 mOhm pack under the 100 A limiter (3.4 V/cell, the CR-B1-16 stand point). The ESC passes full duty at full throttle; ESC drop neglected

nodes.title: Flat-plate normal-force coefficient
nodes.text: Wing normal-force coefficient beyond stall CN = CD90 sin(alpha), CD90 = 1.28
nodes.basis: Hoerner flat plate; the value the K09 card used for hover lean, kept so the numbers compare. Low-AR wings with end plates keep more post-stall lift, so this under-predicts lift in transition (conservative)

nodes.title: ESC efficiency
nodes.text: ESC efficiency 0.95 in hover and cruise
nodes.basis: K09 card value; BLHeli_S at 7-30 A
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Avionics and servo power
nodes.text: FC, GPS, receiver, telemetry, airspeed sensor and two elevon servos draw 6 W together
nodes.basis: card 5 W + 1 W for the two servos

nodes.title: Cruise trim drag factor
nodes.text: Trim adds 2 % to cruise drag on top of B2's trimmed wing polar
nodes.basis: B2's polar (P:b2.avl.e_oswald, cd0_wing) is already trimmed, elevon profile drag included; B3 finds +0.2 % induced trim drag at 16 m/s (CR-B3-07). The 2 % left covers the up-trimmed elevon gap and pod/fin junctions. Was 1.05 (K09 card) before B2/B3 answered

nodes.title: Proposed cruise airspeed 16 m/s
nodes.text: B1 proposes AIRSPEED_CRUISE = 16 m/s (params.json#performance.cruise_ms, CHANGE-LOG D-01)
nodes.basis: lowest whole-number speed above 1.3 Vs at the 2.6 kg gate with B2's trimmed CLmax 0.80 on the c 0.32 wing (15.43 m/s, CL-B1-VT-GATE); +3.7 %, about 0.6 m/s for airspeed-hold and sensor error (R-AIRSPEED-ERR allows 1 m/s, so the margin is thin)

nodes.title: Pessimistic-case factors
nodes.text: [CD0 factor, prop efficiency factor, hover power factor] = [1.30, 0.85, 1.10]; the pessimistic case also uses params wing.oswald_e (0.80) in place of B2's 0.93
nodes.basis: CD0 x 1.3 as the K09 REVIEW pessimistic case; prop efficiency 15 % below APC (BEMT optimism, tractor prop ahead of a fin and tube); hover +10 % for APC static optimism and the 11x4.7 maker table (400 W x 1.10 = 440 W, E2's pessimistic 29.9 A x 14.8 V = 443 W)

nodes.title: Thrust kept for attitude control
nodes.text: Steady flight may use at most 80 % of available thrust (sagged pack); 20 % stays for control
nodes.basis: common multirotor practice (hover throttle <= 50-60 %, never saturate in steady state); a tailsitter controls pitch in hover and transition by differential thrust only

nodes.title: Landing attitude error
nodes.text: Attitude error at touchdown, on top of the steady wind lean, is 10 deg
nodes.basis: first-order allowance for gusts and controller error in QLAND; C5 and H2 refine from the twin's logs

nodes.title: Pitch-over schedule
nodes.text: [pitch rate deg/s, assist speed as a fraction of Vs, back-transition energy as a fraction of the forward pitch-over] = [12, 1.10, 1.0]
nodes.basis: Rev 3 (sag 0.76, D-35): 12 deg/s gives a peak of 0.70 of available thrust in CALC-B1-PITCHOVER on the worst-state pack; 14 gives 0.75, 15 gives 0.77, 16 gives 0.79 and 20 gives 0.88 (performance_results.json#sensitivity). 16 deg/s is now the fastest whole-number rate that keeps <= 0.80, but with no margin while the sag is UNVERIFIED (E1 0.854, E2 0.76; the cold-pack stand run decides), so 12 deg/s stays the first-flight Q_TAILSIT_RAT_FW (rev 2 derived it at sag 0.72, peak 0.76). On a fresh pack 20 deg/s gives 0.59. Thrust holds altitude below 1.1 Vs (Q_ASSIST_SPEED analogue); the back-transition is a pitch-up deceleration of similar length at similar thrust

nodes.title: Aero model: CD0, k, lift slope, stall angle
nodes.equation: CD0 = IF [CD0_wing,B2 f_rough + Cf FF Swet_fins + Cd_tube d L + n CdA_motor + Cf FF Swet_pod + Cd_front (w - w_ref) h + n_b Cd_b w_b l_b + n_c (Cd_c D_c - Cd_tube d) h_c] / S, Swet_fin = 2 A (1 + 0.2 t/c) ; k = 1/(pi AR e_B2) ; k_pess = 1/(pi AR e_params) ; a = CLa (B2 AVL) ; alpha_s = alpha0 + CLmax/a ; L/D max = 1/(2 sqrt(CD0 k))

nodes.title: Stall and transition speeds
nodes.equation: Vs = sqrt(2 m g/(rho S CLmax)) ; Vt = 1.3 Vs ; Vs30 = Vs/sqrt(cos 30) ; margin = Vcruise/Vt - 1

nodes.title: Prop and motor chain, calibrated to the maker table
nodes.equation: n_max = sqrt(T0/(Ct0 rho D^4)) (11x5.5MR) ; n_max,sag = n_max sqrt(sag) ; k_cal = P_table(690 gf) / P_motor(11x4.5MR model at 690 gf, J = 0) ; FM = T^1.5/(sqrt(2 rho A) P_shaft) (11x5.5MR)

nodes.title: Hover power, current, endurance and thrust headroom
nodes.equation: T_motor = m DL / n ; r = P_motor(11x5.5MR, T) / P_motor(11x4.5MR, T) ; P = n P_table(T_motor) r / eta_esc + P_av ; I = P / V ; t_hover = E (1 - reserve) / P ; throttle = m g DL / (n T_max sag)

nodes.title: Cruise at the proposed speed, gate mass
nodes.equation: CL = 2W/(rho V^2 S) ; D = q S (CD0 + k CL^2) trim ; prop: Ct(J) rho n^2 D^4 = D/n ; P_el = n k_cal P_motor(Cp rho n^3 D^5) / eta_esc + P_av ; eta_drive = P_shaft / (P_el - P_av) ; pess: CD0 x 1.3, k_pess (e 0.80), eta_prop x 0.85

nodes.title: Cruise power and cruise time versus airspeed
nodes.equation: for V in 14..20 m/s: P_el(V) as CALC-B1-CRUISE ; t = (E(1-res) - P_h t_h - 2 E_tr)/P_el ; pess: P_h and E_tr x 1.10 and the pessimistic P_el

nodes.title: Mission energy: 2 min hover, two transitions, cruise
nodes.equation: E_use = E (1 - reserve) ; E_c = E_use - P_hover t_hover - E_tr (1 + back) ; t_cruise = E_c / P_cruise ; range = t_cruise V ; pess: P_hover and E_tr x 1.10, P_cruise,pess ; cross-check with B1 hover

nodes.title: Transition corridor, steady level flight
nodes.equation: for V in 0..22 m/s: T cos(th) = D(a=th), T sin(th) + L = W ; corridor th_lo..th_eq with T = (W - L)/sin(th) <= f T_max(V cos a) ; P_el at T/n ; peaks taken over 0 <= V <= Vcruise

nodes.title: Forward transition (pitch-over) time simulation
nodes.equation: m dv/dt = T(th) + L + D - W (2-D point mass, dt 0.01 s, semi-implicit Euler) ; th_cmd = max(90 - r t, th_req(V)) ; T holds altitude below V_assist, speed above

nodes.title: Hover lean, wind limits, landing and ground tip-over
nodes.equation: lean = atan(0.5 rho V^2 S CD90 / W) ; lean_allowed = tipover - err ; V_hover,max: lean = lean_allowed ; T/W at 8 m/s = 1/cos(lean) ; V_ground,tip = sqrt(2 m_min g z_fin / (h_cp rho S CD90)), h_cp = c/2 + foot

nodes.title: Vertical climb, fixed-wing climb and top speed
nodes.equation: VTOL: T = W DL + q S_front CD0 at Vc, prop at J = Vc/(nD) ; full throttle at V: n = min(n_V, n_I, n_cap) from V_term = n 60/Kv + I Rm, I = Q/kt + I0 <= I_lim ; T = n_props Ct(J) rho n^2 D^4 ; FW: ROC = (f T(V) - D) V / W (worst pack) ; V_max: T(V) = D(V) ; V_H at the rpm cap, fresh pack, base drag ; V_max,sag worst pack ; pitch speed = p n_cap

nodes.title: Fin drag from 2-D section RANS
nodes.text: Each fin's zero-lift drag is the SU2 2-D section Cd (fully turbulent SA, 16 m/s) times its chord, over the tube length for the tube + board section and over the rest of the fin height for the bare board; the rev 3 interference factor 1.15 is kept on top for the root and tip junctions
nodes.basis: the board edges are square (laser- or knife-cut foam board, fins SPEC) and trip the boundary layer, so fully turbulent SA is the right model on the fins; tip and root 3-D effects are small at h/c 0.76 per half-fin and stay inside the 1.15 factor; 3 mm epoxy fillet at the tube-board joint (fins.fin.le_gap_m filled), board edges sharp. Re 3.0e5

nodes.title: Lightest flying mass below the A3 basic mass
nodes.text: The lightest flying configuration is the A3 basic mass with the 503 g pack instead of the 550 g pack, 47 g lighter; it sets the hover wind lean and the parked tip-over wind
nodes.basis: team/A3/rollup/rollup.json pack_cases 503/550 (A3-R6a)

nodes.title: As-designed drag polar from AVL + XFOIL (wing) and SU2 (fins)
nodes.equation: CD0 = IF [A_fit f_rough + n_f c_f (Cd_A L_tube + Cd_B (2 h_f - L_tube)) + n CdA_m + pod + pod_front + braces + collars] / S ; k = K_fit (AVL CDi + XFOIL lift-dependent profile, trimmed) ; k_pess = 1/(pi AR e_params) ; alpha0_trim = alpha_cruise - CL_cruise / CLa

nodes.title: Stall and transition speeds, as designed
nodes.equation: SM = (Xnp_B2 - x_cg,A3)/c ; CLmax_B2 = interp(SM, B2 CLmax(SM)) ; CLmax = min(CLmax_B1 sim, CLmax_B2) ; Vs = sqrt(2 m g/(rho S CLmax)) at m_basic, m_pred, m_gate ; Vt = 1.3 Vs

nodes.title: Hover at the as-designed mass, canted motors
nodes.equation: m_eff = m / cos(cant) ; P, I, throttle, T/W as CALC-B1-HOVER at m_eff ; T/W fresh = n T_max cos(cant) / (m g DL)

nodes.title: Cruise at 16 m/s, as-designed mass and drag
nodes.equation: as CALC-B1-CRUISE with m = A3 predicted, CD0 and k from CALC-B1V-AERO ; also at the 2.6 kg gate ; sweep 14-20 m/s

nodes.title: Corridor and pitch-over, as designed
nodes.equation: CALC-B1-CORRIDOR and CALC-B1-PITCHOVER with m = A3 predicted, CLa, trimmed alpha0, CLmax_trim, CD0, k as designed; Vs from CALC-B1V-STALL

nodes.title: Mission: 2 min hover, two transitions, cruise; as designed
nodes.equation: E_c = E (1 - res) - P_h t_h - E_tr (1 + back) ; t = E_c / P_cruise ; pess: (P_h t_h + E_tr (1 + back)) x 1.10 and P_cruise,pess

nodes.title: Top level speed at F4's fixed-wing throttle cap and FW climb, as designed
nodes.equation: CALC-B1-CLIMB with m = A3 predicted, as-designed CD0 and k, rpm cap = CL-F4-FW-RPM-CAP (THR_MAX 70 %) ; VH / (VD / 1.25) <= 1 ; also at the 9 350 rpm VTOL cap

nodes.title: Wind limits at the lightest flying mass
nodes.equation: CALC-B1-WIND with m = A3 basic - 47 g (503 g pack): lean = atan(q S CD90 / W) ; tip-over wind with m_min = the same mass

nodes.title: Numerical uncertainty of the simulations

nodes.title: No net knock-down on CLmax
nodes.text: Design CLmax = 1.0 x the critical-section CLmax built on the XFOIL clmax envelope
nodes.basis: XFOIL tends to over-predict clmax at Re 2-3e5 by a few per cent, while the critical-section method under-predicts a low-AR rectangular wing (stall spreads before CL peaks) and the clmax envelope is already the lower of Re 2.3e5 / 3.0e5; the biases offset. Replaced by the slow-flight stall T-B2-STALL
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Dive speed 1.3 x cruise
nodes.text: Elevon hinge moments are sized at 1.3 x cruise speed with full 25 deg travel

nodes.title: Inviscid hinge moment is the bound
nodes.text: Design hinge moment = XFOIL inviscid HMOM, the larger of viscous and inviscid
nodes.basis: converged viscous XFOIL values are 70-80 % of inviscid at +10..+25 deg; viscous up-deflection cases do not converge (separated), so the inviscid value is used for both directions

nodes.title: Foam over the spar >= 2 mm

nodes.basis: hot-wire kerf ~1 mm plus slot tolerance; thinner foam tears when the slot is cut (G2 confirms)

nodes.title: Stall polars valid within 10 % of their Re

nodes.basis: S5010 clmax changes ~0.02 per 0.3e5 of Re in this band (Re 2.0-3.0e5 polars, xfoil_results.json)

nodes.title: Quasi-steady transition pitch balance
nodes.equation: level flight at V: T cos a = D, T sin a + L = W ; wing CP from Xnp (attached) to 0.5 c at 90 deg ; props' normal force at x_prop ; elevon (dp - slop) deg at Cmd eta e_D6(V) ; hub term (R5, B4 BEMT): M_hub = n H min(1, V/V_h) |x_cg - x_prop| added to |M_aero| at every point, H = CL-B4-SIM-H-MAX (hover rpm) or CL-B4-SIM-H-HOVERT (hover thrust held, bounding) ; use = (|M_aero| + M_hub - M_elevon) / (2 dT 2z), dT = min(T/4, Tmax sag - T/4)

nodes.title: Pack voltage at the end of a flight, loaded
nodes.text: 4S pack at 3.4 V/cell under full-throttle load
nodes.basis: 4S 6500 130C late in the flight; same basis as the K09 review section (3.4 V/cell)

nodes.title: Cylinder drag coefficient 1.1
nodes.text: 22 mm tube in the slipstream, Re ~1.3e4 (subcritical)
nodes.basis: Hoerner, Fluid-Dynamic Drag, ch. 3: Cd 1.0-1.2 for 1e4 < Re < 2e5

nodes.title: Slipstream peak-to-mean dynamic pressure 1.3
nodes.text: A real prop loads its outer half: the tube sees about 1.3 x the mean slipstream dynamic pressure
nodes.basis: typical blade loading peak near 0.75 R; bounds the uniform-disk value from above
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Foot frontal area 30 x 30 mm
nodes.text: crushable printed foot on each fin TE tip, near the prop axis
nodes.basis: bounds D5's GER-001 shoe over the 9.6 mm fin TE (subsystems/landing/SPEC.md: 11 x 18 mm cartridge in a sleeve); D5 publishes no frontal area

nodes.title: Sharp-edged strip and ear drag coefficient 1.2
nodes.text: 10 x 3 mm pultruded CF brace broadside to the flow with its 10 mm side along x (depth/height 3.3), and the printed collar ears (blunt prisms)
nodes.basis: Hoerner, Fluid-Dynamic Drag, ch. 3, and Delany & Sorensen NACA TN 3038: sharp rectangular sections at depth/height 3 have Cd 1.1-1.4 (on the height) at Re 1e3-1e4
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: ESC on its pad: 8 mm proud of the board, Cd 0.9
nodes.text: LANRC 45 A board in heat-shrink with a 10 mm hook-and-loop strap, on the 1.2 mm PETG pad; frontal = pad height x (pad + ESC), blunt box of length/thickness ~5
nodes.basis: E1 has not published ESC dimensions (PRP-002); typical 45 A BLHeli_S board 5 mm thick + heat-shrink and strap; Hoerner ch. 3 blunt box
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Cant sense per F4's motor map (k = +1)
nodes.text: the side component of each canted thrust points toward the wing plane and outboard, so each hover wake leans away from the wing and inboard, and each disc's wing-side edge swings aft toward the tube
nodes.basis: subsystems/flight-software/SPEC.md motor table and 'Cant sense' (CL-F4-MOTOR-MAP); D3's fin_detail.mount.cant_sense_UR +1 is the opposite (CR-B4-16)

nodes.title: Shear-layer spreading 0.08
nodes.text: the slipstream edge mixing layer grows 0.08 m per metre downstream on each side
nodes.basis: plane mixing layer vorticity thickness growth ~0.16-0.18 dx at velocity ratio 0 (Brown and Roshko 1974); half toward each side

nodes.title: Pitot error limit 2 %
nodes.text: thrust-dependent airspeed error at the probe tip must stay within 2 % of true airspeed (a constant bias is removed by ARSPD_RATIO; a thrust-dependent one is not)
nodes.basis: B4 choice; ArduPilot airspeed calibration removes only a constant ratio

nodes.title: Vortex-ring onset at 0.28 v_h
nodes.text: vortex-ring state begins at a descent rate of about 0.28 times the hover induced velocity
nodes.basis: Leishman, Principles of Helicopter Aerodynamics 2nd ed., sec. 2.14: VRS boundary from about -0.28 v_h (onset) to -1.0 v_h; conservative lower edge

nodes.title: Pitot boom 80 mm ahead of the pod front at z 0.045 m
nodes.text: plug-in pitot boom on the pod nose, probe along body x, tip 80 mm ahead of the pod front face, 30 mm above the pod base
nodes.basis: B4 placement (CR-B4-05); D2 draws POD-006; the tip x follows pod.x_le_m if the pod moves

nodes.title: Fin effective aspect ratio doubles on the wing
nodes.text: the wing acts as an end plate at the fin root inside the slipstream
nodes.basis: image method for a plate ending on a wall

nodes.title: APC data transcription check
nodes.equation: Ct' = T / (rho n^2 D^4) ; Cp' = P / (rho n^3 D^5) from the printed N and W ; error = max |Ct'/Ct - 1|, |Cp'/Cp - 1| over rows with Ct, Cp >= 0.02 (4-digit rounding < 0.25 %)

nodes.title: Static operating points, five candidate props
nodes.equation: hover: T_h = k_dl m g / (4 cos cant) -> rpm, P_shaft from Ct, Cp ; FM = T^1.5 / sqrt(2 rho A) / P_shaft ; full throttle: (V - rpm/Kv)/R = Q/Kt + I0 (E1 constants, hot winding) ; T/W (bus held, no current limit) = 4 T_max cos cant / (k_dl m g) ; rpm limit = K / D_in (APC)

nodes.title: Cruise operating point, five props, all four motors running
nodes.equation: T = m g / (L/D) / 4 ; solve rpm: Ct(J) rho n^2 D^4 = T at V ; eta_p = T V / P_shaft ; P_in = (rpm/Kv + I R) I + P_esc (E1 constants, 25 degC winding) ; total = 4 P_in

nodes.title: Hover download on tube, collars, braces, ESC pads, half-fins, feet and wing
nodes.equation: v_i = sqrt(T / 2 rho A) ; v(s) = v_i (1 + s / sqrt(s^2 + R^2)) ; r_s = R / sqrt(v/v_i) ; wake axis along the canted shaft from the hub (cant, sense k) ; item drag = Cd q A for every tube, collar, ear, brace and ESC element inside r_s and outside the motor-can shadow ; fin: 2 Cf q h_w dx over the wetted strip of the half-fin plane (top edge from the station collar to the TE tip) ; base 0.5 q t h_w (t = board x layers) ; foot q A at half speed ; wing: reach = r_s + mix s, gap = z_c - reach - z_surf ; k = 1 + D/T

nodes.title: Cruise drag of the R3 fin hardware (collars, ears, braces, ESC pads)
nodes.equation: T = m g / (L/D) / 4 ; v from T = 2 rho A v (V + v) ; inside the slipstream (r < R about the x-parallel cruise wake) u = V + v (1 + s / sqrt(s^2 + R^2)), else V ; D = sum Cd 0.5 rho u^2 A x 4 stations ; dCD0 = D / (q S), S = b c ; share = D / (m g / (L/D)) ; dP = P_cruise x share

nodes.title: Slipstream edge versus elevons and wing (canted, leaning hover wake)
nodes.equation: hover: inner edge z = z_c(x) - r_s(s) - mix s, wake centre z_c from the hub along the canted shaft ; elevon tip z = c_e sin(delta_max) ; cruise: wake along x, r_s ~ R (lightly loaded) ; gap = edge - surface ; _alt = mirrored spin map (wake leans toward the wing)

nodes.title: Pitot tip x station from the pod nose and the boom
nodes.equation: x_tip = pod.x_le_m - boom

nodes.title: Prop-induced airspeed error at pitot candidates
nodes.equation: v from T = 2 rho A v (V + v) ; four semi-infinite vortex cylinders, gamma = 2 v, each from its canted hub along the resultant of V (+x) and v (canted shaft) ; u = u_axial e + u_radial r_hat (elliptic K, E) ; error = u_x / V ; grid: Simpson N = 100/200/400, wake length 20/40/80 R

nodes.title: Fin side force from swirl and cant, and hover yaw authority
nodes.equation: Gamma_s = Q / (rho v_i pi (R^2 - r_h^2)) ; v_t = Gamma_s / r ; v_n = v_t (normal part) + v_a e_y/e_x (canted wake lean) ; alpha = atan(v_n / v_a) ; dF = a(AR) alpha q dA (Helmbold, AR = 2 h_w / c) ; M_body = sum z dF (about the body x-axis) ; yaw factor = 1 + M_body / Q ; yaw per N of differential thrust = (Q/T) factor + r_arm sin(cant) ; half-fin root moment = F (z_cp - z_root)

nodes.title: Prop spacing and blade-to-tube gap with the canted discs, descent limit, ground effect and tones
nodes.equation: hub moved stack sin(cant) along the thrust side ; disc plane normal n = canted shaft ; blade x over a point (y, z) = x_hub + (n_y dy + n_z dz) / (-n_x) ; gap = x_face - x_blade over the tube and collars inside R ; gap_v = 2 (z_hub - R sqrt(1 - n_z^2)) ; v_h = sqrt(k m g / (8 rho A)) ; V_d,max = 0.28 v_h ; T_IGE/T = 1 / (1 - (R / 4 h)^2) ; M_tip = pi D n / a ; BPF = 2 n

nodes.title: Exact blade-tip clearance to the wing skin and to the tube, canted disc, blade envelope (R4)
nodes.equation: hub = (x_prop, y + s sin(cant) t_y, z + s sin(cant) t_z) ; n = (-cos, sin t_y, sin t_z) ; for every S5010 surface point p (x 0..c, |y - y_m| <= R + 30 mm): t = -(p - hub).n (+ aft), rr = |(p - hub) - (-t) n| ; dt = max(0, -fwd - t, t - aft) ; gap = dt if rr <= R else hypot(dt, rr - R) ; min over the surface ; upper stations see the upper surface, lower stations the lower (mirror) ; same for the tube surface (z 0..L/2) ; keep-out cylinder test = rr - R for points with -(10 mm + clr) <= t <= 10 mm + clr

nodes.title: UIUC-measured cross-check of the APC predictions
nodes.equation: static: Ct_UIUC / Ct_APC and Cp_UIUC / Cp_APC at J = 0, top measured rpm ; FM ratio = (Ct ratio)^1.5 / Cp ratio ; cruise: solve Ct_UIUC(J) rho n^2 D^4 = T at V ; eta = T V / P

nodes.title: Unlimited full-throttle rpm on a fresh pack and the output cap that respects the APC limit
nodes.equation: (V - rpm/Kv)/R = Q(rpm)/Kt + I0, cold winding (lowest R, highest rpm), V = max OCV ; cap: find V_eff giving rpm = 0.98 x 105000/D_in ; duty = V_eff / V_ocv,max ; T/W at the cap = 4 T(rpm_cap) cos cant / (k_dl m g)

nodes.title: Isolated static thrust A/B: 11x5.5MR and 11x4.5MR on one X3108S
nodes.procedure: H1 stand (shared with T-E1-STAND), 14.8 V, 10 % throttle steps; log thrust, torque, rpm, V, A.

nodes.title: Installed thrust with the R3 fin station mock-up and a wing strip
nodes.procedure: Same stand; the printed 7 deg canted mount on a 22 mm tube cut to the R3 end (0.172 m from the chord plane), mount and station collars with their ears, one 10 x 3 mm brace strip to a dummy anchor, an ESC dummy (8 x 28 x 46 mm) on the pad station, a two-layer 0.21 m half-fin with the R3 top edge, and a 0.32 m S5010 wing strip at the right offset; measure the blade-tip gap over the tube by hand first; compare thrust at equal rpm with and without; repeat with the brace and ESC removed, then the fin, then the strip.

nodes.title: Fin side force and yaw moment from swirl and cant
nodes.procedure: Stand with torque cell and the 7 deg canted mount; the half-fin mock-up on its own side-force cell (two load points give the centre of pressure); at hover thrust record reaction torque and fin side force, then with the 0 deg mount. Body-axis yaw factor = 1 + F z_cp / Q.

nodes.title: Cruise prop check, car-top or flight
nodes.procedure: Car-top rig at performance.cruise_ms (GPS) or logged level cruise on the twin: rpm, current, voltage; compare with CALC-B4-CRUISE.

nodes.title: PER3 hover shaft power x 1.047
nodes.text: APC PER3 over-predicts static figure of merit by 4.5 % on both APC 11 in props with UIUC data (CL-B4-XCHECK); hover shaft power is carried at PER3 x 1/0.955
nodes.basis: team/B4/props.py CALC-B4-XCHECK fm_ratio_static 0.955 (11x4.7SF and 11x5.5E)

nodes.title: Blade section NACA 4412 (BEMT)
nodes.text: APC thin-electric blade modelled with NACA 4412 polars (XFOIL, Ncrit 5); NACA 3410 as the low-camber bound
nodes.basis: UIUC publishes chord and twist only; NACA 4412 / Clark-Y are the usual APC surrogates. Checked here against UIUC 11x5.5E data (static within 3 %)
nodes.value: NACA 4412
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Epoxy fillet radius 3 mm at the tube-board junction
nodes.text: the 0.5 mm board-to-tube gap is filled by an epoxy fillet (fin_detail.fin.le_gap_m); CFD section uses a 3 mm concave fillet
nodes.basis: G2 practice for a thickened-epoxy fillet on foam board; the result is insensitive to 1-5 mm (nose separation is set by the tube shoulder)
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Fully turbulent SA RANS for the tube-board section
nodes.text: steady incompressible RANS, Spalart-Allmaras, fully turbulent; the prop slipstream is highly turbulent (blade wakes every 5.5 ms), so the board boundary layer is taken as turbulent from the tube
nodes.basis: Leishman, ch. 10 (slipstream turbulence); a laminar steady solve diverged (vortex shedding at Re_D 1.5e4), which is itself evidence the flow is not laminar-steady
nodes.value: SA

nodes.title: UIUC Propeller Database vol. 1, measured blade geometry APC 11x5.5E and 11x4.7SF
nodes.where: apce_11x5.5_geom.txt, apcsf_11x4.7_geom.txt -> team/B4/data/uiuc_*_geom.csv

nodes.title: Steady cylinder drag at Re 40 (Dennis and Chang 1970; Fornberg 1980)
nodes.where: Dennis & Chang JFM 42: Cd 1.522 (pressure 0.99, friction 0.53) at Re 40; Fornberg JFM 98: 1.498
nodes.note: used to validate the SU2 set-up, mesh family and force integration

nodes.title: As-designed hover operating points (A3 roll-up, hover split, rpm cap)
nodes.equation: W = m g k_dl ; per pair: upper/lower = s ; T_u = W s / (2 (1 + s) cos(cant)) ; T_l = T_u / s ; rpm, shaft power from APC PER3 (11x5.5MR) x 1.047 ; T_cap = PER3 thrust at rpm_max ; headroom = T_cap / T_u ; T/W_cap = 4 T_cap cos(cant) / (m g) ; m_heavy = gate - margin_680

nodes.title: BEMT validation against UIUC (11x5.5E), convergence, PER3 static cross-check
nodes.equation: annulus momentum + blade element, Prandtl tip/hub loss, swirl ; error = BEMT / UIUC - 1 at the measured rpm and J ; convergence: N = 10/20/40/80 radial elements (static, hover rpm) ; FM = T^1.5 / sqrt(2 rho A) / P

nodes.title: Prop at incidence in the pitch-over: thrust, power and in-plane H-force (BEMT)
nodes.equation: i = angle between the free stream and the shaft ; Vx = V cos i, Vt = V sin i ; quasi-steady blade element per azimuth (M stations) with local momentum ; T, P, H averaged over psi ; fixed rpm = the BEMT rpm for the hover thrust (static) ; H/T and dH/di at V_t

nodes.title: Tube + board section drag (SU2 RANS, grids L0/L1/L2) in the hover download and cruise
nodes.equation: Cd_hand = Cd_tube + 2 Cf (L_b / D) + 0.5 t / D, Cf = 0.074 Re_L^-0.2 (props.py terms) ; Cd_CFD = Richardson value on L2/L1/L0 (GCI band) ; backed fraction f = (z_board_top - z_skin) / (z_tube_end - z_skin) ; dD = D_tube f (Cd_CFD - Cd_hand) / Cd_tube ; k_new = k + dD / (m g / 4) ; cruise: D_tube+board = Cd_CFD 0.5 rho V^2 D h_backed x 4

nodes.title: Rotor limit loads per motor and design dive speed
nodes.equation: T_cap = kT_E1 T_h (rpm_cap/rpm_h)^2 ; T_ilim = t_ilim g ; T_lim = max(T_req, T_cap) ; rpm_lim = rpm_h sqrt(T_lim / (kT_E1 T_h)) ; Q = kP_E1 Q_h (rpm_lim/rpm_h)^2 ; H = (m_p D^2/12 + I_bell) omega ; M_gyro = H q_max ; V_pitch = p rpm_fw/60 (fixed-wing rpm at F4's THR_MAX) ; VH = max(V_pitch, V_lvl_F4) ; VD = f_D max(Vc, VH) rounded UP to 0.1 m/s ; VD_uncapped = f_D max(Vc, VMAX_B1) (information) ; n_hover = n T_lim / (m g)

nodes.title: V-n diagram: manoeuvre and gust envelope
nodes.equation: Vs = sqrt(2W/(rho S CLmax)); VA = Vs sqrt(n+); a = CL_alpha (B2 AVL); mu = 2(W/S)/(rho c a g); kg = 0.88mu/(5.3+mu); dn = kg rho U V a / (2 W/S); n_gust = min(stall line, 1 +/- dn), U = Ude_C to VC then linear to f Ude_C at VD; VD = max(VD_req, VD_C1); design n = max(requirement, gust)

nodes.title: Landing, wingtip strike, tip-over and stance-in-wind loads
nodes.equation: feet (constant-force cartridge, eta_f): n_L = v^2/(2 g eta_f s) + 1 - L/W at s = s_min (requirement) and s = foot height (bound) ; s_req = v^2 / (2 g eta_f (n_target - 1 + L/W)) ; F_foot at n_target = m_eff g (n_target - 1 + L/W) + (1 - L/W) W/4 with m_eff = 1/(1/m + (r x n).I^-1.(r x n)) ; level upper foot x bias ; wingtip strike roll = atan(foot / (b/2 - y_fin)) ; foot_req = (b/2 - y_fin) tan(attitude) ; tip-over: KE = m g r (1 - cos(phi0 + theta_c)) ; F = KE / (eta s) ; stance wind: q S CD h = W d

nodes.title: Crash factor and pack retention load
nodes.equation: n_c = v^2 / (2 g s) ; F_pack = m_pack_max n_c g (ultimate, emergency)

nodes.title: Box drop load factor
nodes.equation: n_T = 1 + h / (eta s)

nodes.title: Lumped-model mass properties against A3's roll-up
nodes.equation: I_model from the lumped masses at the gate (MC-C, MC-P, after the Iyy match) ; ratio = I_model / (I_A3 x s) per axis, s = 1 for MC-C (growth at the CG) and m_gate / m_A3 for MC-P (pro rata) ; trim dx = centre-group x shift that puts the model CG on the limit ; d = centre-group spread

nodes.title: D5's per-type foot loads inside C1's level-landing bound
nodes.equation: r_lim = F_peak_upper(D5) / F_level_upper(C1) ; r_ult = F_ult_upper(D5) / (SF F_level_upper(C1))

nodes.title: Load envelope over every case and both mass configurations
nodes.equation: per case: a = F/m, alpha = I^-1 M_cg ; cut load = sum over the outboard part of (applied + m (g - a - alpha x r)) ; envelope = max over cases F, H, T, L1-L5, G and mass configs MC-C, MC-P ; ultimate = SF x limit ; joints x fitting factor ; transport n_allow = n_T x min(envelope / transport) ; s_req = h / (eta (n_allow - 1))

nodes.title: Wing proof load at limit (the one wing limit proof, run as H1 GT-08)
nodes.procedure: Aircraft inverted, supported under the pod with the half-fins hanging free; four-pad whiffletree per side over the spar at CL-C1-PROOF-Y1/-Y2/-Y3/-Y4 loaded to CL-C1-PROOF-P1/P2/P3/P4-LIM, plus the upward relief pull CL-C1-PROOF-R-LIM at each motor tube (LIMIT; data/whiffletree.json); hold 3 s, no permanent set after unloading; tip deflection logged. Step 2, each side in turn (rolling cases): padded V-block under the spar at CL-C1-PROOF-OUT-SUPPORT-Y, pads 3 and 4 at CL-C1-PROOF-OUT-P3/P4-LIM. Ultimate (x 1.5) on a sacrificial wing only. Torsion: twist test at CL-C1-WING-TORSION-ULT / 1.5; the G2 tube-end handling moment: T-C1-STATION-PROOF (CR-H1-13, agreed with C2).

nodes.title: Foot drop test at 1.5 m/s
nodes.procedure: 0.115 m free drop of the aircraft (or a 2.6 kg dummy on one fin) onto its feet, accelerometer at the CG; level and 10 deg tilted; n <= 6.

nodes.title: Max thrust on a fresh pack
nodes.procedure: H1 thrust stand, one station, 11x5.5MR, 16.8 V pack, F4 output cap and 100 A limiter as flown: step to full throttle, record peak thrust, torque and rpm.

nodes.title: Motor-station proof load
nodes.procedure: Hang the limit mount load from each motor mount in -x and y with the wing supported at the spar. G2 step (CR-H1-13): wing held under the pod, a load equal to the G2 fin-group cut (data/envelope.json, J-FIN in G2-HANG-MOTOR) hung at the UR upper tube end at LIMIT; no permanent set.

nodes.equation: design allowable = C6 knock-down x typical: XPS shear kd tau_xps, epoxy on the paper face kd tau_b, board flat-wise kd f_b

nodes.title: Pod-to-wing bond: flight/ground envelope and crash
nodes.equation: loads moved from C1's point (pod centre, base) to the bond centroid: M' = M + (r_ref - r_c) x F; footprint b x L, x 0 ... recess end; sigma = Fz/A + 6|My|/(b L^2) + 6|Mx|/(L b^2) (tension only); tau = |Fxy|/A + |Mz| r_max / J; R = sigma/sigma_a + tau/tau_a; design = limit x SF x k_fit x k_print; crash: m_group n_c g any axis at the group CG (A3 roll-up items + heaviest pack at the most forward station), no further factor

nodes.title: Pack stops: aft stop wall (+x), forward stop (-x)
nodes.equation: F_design = max over cases of the pack force x SF x k_fit x k_print; crash F = C1 85 N; sigma = 6 F (pad + h/2) / (b t^2) aft (pack bears from the pad top to the stop top), 6 F (h/2) / (b t^2) fwd (block on the tray); b = bay + 2 guides; fuse load of the forward stop F_f = sigma_a b t^2 / (6 h_f / 2); t_req = sqrt(6 F h/2 / (b sigma_a)); nose wall (foam board) as a strip between the side walls: M = F/4 (S - c/2), m_cap = sigma_f t_f (t - t_f) per unit width over the pack height

nodes.title: Bay guides (+-y) and strap legs in a lateral crash
nodes.equation: q = F / L_pack on the guide, resultant at h/2: sigma = 6 q (h/2) / t^2; overturn about the far guide top: T_legs = F (z_pack/2 + pad - h) / w_bay, per strap = T_legs / n

nodes.title: Straps (+z): loop tension, hook-and-loop overlap, tray and floor under the strap
nodes.equation: per strap P = max(F_flight x SF x k_fit x k_print, F_crash) / n; leg T = P/2 + preload/(2n); overlap_req = T / (tau_hl w); tray flat-wise = P / (w_tray (w + 2 s)); front strap on the overhang: floor-to-wall glue line q = P / (2 (w + 2 s)), stress = q / t_board (as drawn) or q / (t_board + fillet leg) with C6's corner fillet (CR-C6-17)

nodes.title: Pod overhang ahead of the wing LE: section at x = 0
nodes.equation: M = n g [m_pack,ahead x_bar + sum m_i |x_i|] (pack uniform over its length at the forward stop); section = foam-board faces only: 2 side walls (2 faces t_f x h_w) + floor bottom face (strap groove cuts the top face); tray left out (strap slot at x 0); sigma_top = M c / I

nodes.title: Carry handle on the spar (G1, whole aircraft at 2 g)
nodes.equation: F = m_gate g n_h x SF x k_fit x k_print; ties: F vs n x rating; grip: uniform hand load over the leg span s = 2 y_leg, M = F s / 8, sigma = 6 M / (b h^2)

nodes.title: Hatch suction at VD
nodes.equation: F = |Cp| q_VD A_hatch x SF x k_fit; aft half on the hook-and-loop tab: sigma = F/2 / A_tab

nodes.title: Pod mass: C3 sizing against D2's model, and the full-section forward stop option
nodes.equation: dm = rho [(t_aft,rec - t_aft,D2) h_a b + (t_fwd,rec - t_fwd,D2) h_f b + 2 (t_g,rec - t_g,D2) h_g L_bay]; m = CL-D2-MASS + dm; full-section option (CR-C5-13): + rho t_fwd b (H_bay - h_f)

nodes.title: Nose-in crush path with the D-47 nose (8.8 mm nose stack, block A ~1 mm)
nodes.equation: L_A = (x_fs - t_fs) - (x_le + t_b) ; per pack m (503/550/680 g): F = min(n_pack m g, sigma A_bay), KE = m v^2/2, eff = eps_d - eps_y/2 ; block A energy E_A = min(F, sigma A_stop) eff L_A, share = E_A/KE ; block B gap penalty of a stop of height h_f vs the full section = (min(F, sigma A_bay) - min(F, sigma h_f b_bay)) L_A / F ; same at the D2-R3/R4 block A (ASM-D2-FWD-STOP[0]) for comparison ; stack = t_b + L_A + t_fs

nodes.title: FEA verification of the pod load path (SU2 ELASTICITY, 4 mesh levels)
nodes.equation: bond design R = R_hand(full 3-D row) x R_FEA,in-plane / R_hand,in-plane (FEA concentration factor on the hand calc's Fz, My, Fx part; d0-averaged peaks); bond crash R = max over +-x, +-z of R_FEA (d0); overhang = wall-top face stress E_f exx at x = 0 (section fit); stops: peak principal stress at the root fillet, tray bending peak, board flat-wise peel (paper face to core, 2 mm mean), per variant

nodes.title: Aft-stop strut to the handle foot bridge (CR-C3-14 fix)
nodes.equation: rib bearing sigma = F / (n t h); Euler per rib (pinned, conservative) pi^2 E (h t^3 / 12) / L^2, x n; bridge: F vs the 2 spar ties (+x along the spar); mass = rho (n t h L + w_p h t_p)

nodes.title: Bond coupons: epoxy on F-250 and on paper-faced board
nodes.procedure: Build epoxy, 24 h cure. Three 50 x 50 mm PETG pads on F-250 offcut and three on board: flat-wise pull to failure (spring scale or luggage scale). Three 25 x 50 mm lap shears on F-250. Record failure load and mode (foam / paper / adhesive). Allowable = mean - 2 s, foam or paper failure required.

nodes.title: Printed stop wall and guide push test
nodes.procedure: Print the tray rear piece (with the strut on a handle-bridge offcut) and the tray front piece, same settings as flight, and epoxy each to a foam-board floor offcut as built (the FEA shows the board peel governs, so a bare tray proves nothing). Push a 50 x 50 mm block at 16 mm above the tray to 90 N (aft, +x) and at 13 mm to 85 N (forward, -x, with the 1 mm bed and a nose-wall offcut), 85 N spread over 60 mm (guide); no crack, no board delamination, set < 0.5 mm. Then to failure once.

nodes.title: Built pod on the wing: proof loads with a 680 g dummy pack
nodes.procedure: Wing on its spar ends. Dummy pack (680 g, pack size) strapped in. Pull the dummy pack with a luggage scale at 1.5 x the design value to the slowest-failing direction: down (overhang) 64 N, up 85 N, aft 85 N, sideways 85 N, 10 s each; inspect the bond edges, nose and wall tops for creases.

nodes.title: Station modes, one board layer (rejected option CR-D3-02) on the R3 geometry, upper UR and lower LR, nominal E/G
nodes.equation: FE (fin_fe.build_q): tube frame + 1-layer board (mapped Q4 shell) + edge strips + brace (EA/L in series with the anchor) + mount springs + motor/prop/mount rigid body; station mode = >= 10 % of kinetic energy in the rigid body; sep = min |f/f_k - 1| over 1P/2P hover, 1P/2P cruise, 1P cap

nodes.title: Station modes, recommended: D3 geometry with fins.layers boards (params), brace and edge strips, nominal E/G
nodes.equation: as CALC-C4-D3-MODES with the board layers from params.json (fins.layers)

nodes.title: Separation over the tube E/G corners, recommended design
nodes.equation: min over side x E {lo, nom, hi} x G {lo, nom, hi} of sep_op (18 FE runs), mount and root at their nominal springs

nodes.title: Mount rocking stiffness estimate with the R5 cheeks (7.5 mm face_ahead)
nodes.equation: series springs: collar foundation k_f = (E / t_wall) d l_grip^3 / 12; nodding (about y) = two cheeks as deep beams over the free length a = x_meet - x_back (x_back = x_face + t_plate / cos c, x_meet = x_tube - sqrt(r_col^2 - y_cheek^2)): k = E 2 t h^3 / 12 / a, h = z_st + plate_hz - (L_tube/2 - ear_h/2); sway (about x) = plate + cheeks as a channel cantilevered from the lip-cap top to the motor axis: I = t_p (2 hy)^3 / 12 + 2 l_cheek t (y_cheek + t/2)^2, k = E I / (z_st - L_tube/2 - t_cap); k_axis = 1/(1/k_f + 1/k_body); k_est = min over the two axes; R4 for comparison: plate 5 mm aft, cheeks 5 mm shorter

nodes.title: Mount rocking stiffness needed for the separation rule, recommended design
nodes.equation: sweep k_rock over 500-30 000 N m/rad (k_twist fixed) on both quarters at nominal and low E/G; k_req = smallest k with sep_op >= sep_min at every larger k (log interpolation)

nodes.title: Mesh convergence, recommended design (both sides)
nodes.equation: first dominant station mode f1 (>= 50 % kinetic energy in the motor body) and sep_op at fin meshes 12x10, 24x20 (used), 36x30; change = max over sides of |f1(24x20)/f1(36x30) - 1| and |sep(24x20)/sep(36x30) - 1| (f2 reported only: near 360-600 Hz it swaps between coupled modes)

nodes.title: Gyroscopic whirl separation, recommended design (both sides)
nodes.equation: M q'' + Omega G q' + K q = 0 on 16 modes, G = -[Ip_spin e_shaft]x at the station, e_shaft = (-cos c, s sin c t_y, s sin c t_z) with the tangential cant c and both senses s = +/-1; sep over 1P/2P at hover and cruise and 1P at the cap, station whirl modes only; f_whirl_* = whirl frequencies of the first station mode at hover and cruise rpm (lowest over sides and senses)

nodes.title: Fin, tube, brace, collar, edge-strip bond and anchor strength, recommended design (both sides, LE fillet intact and cracked)
nodes.equation: FE static, limit cases L1 (C1 peak foot), L4 (side = max(mu F_corner, C5 side load), both senses), L5 (both senses), foot loads at the C1 ground point (x_te + foot_h, z_pad) through a rigid D5 shoe on the square tip; G2 (both senses, n_h m g at the tube end), H2c (T_lim along the 7 deg canted shaft at the prop centre + Q about the shaft, 4 sign combinations), H2s = H2c + B4 misbuilt swirl x (T_lim/T_hover)^exp as a line load at the B4 centre of pressure, both senses; G3 (lower quarter) set-down force at the motor body toward the wing; envelope over upper/lower quarter and LE fillet intact / cracked between the boss and the collar, and (R5, CR-C2-12) root fillet absent (root free, intact bucket at ultimate); section torque at the wing plane from the FE reactions (fin root + boss nodes, tube root spring, brace anchor) vs C1's wing-plane torque, equilibrium residual vs the applied torque; ultimate = sf x limit (joints x fit x prt); face MS = min(intact at ultimate, LE fillet cracked at limit (fail-safe)), face stress = Q_f (eps0 + z kappa); collar torque = jump of the tube torque across the collar band; strip-to-paper shear flow per face q = |dN|/2/ds + |V|/d (nodes inside the D5 shoe, x >= tip_clear_x, excluded), tau = q/w vs kd tau_board; strip end force per face = |N0|/2 + |M0|/d, the other strip of the pair N0/2 -/+ M0/d (signed, same case), pair sum |N0|; root fillet share (intact): -reactions at the pinned root nodes split at x_hinge, force and moment about each segment centroid, fillet / applied moment about the chord axis; pin force = q jf pitch; brace Pcr = pi^2 E w t^3 / (12 L^2); brace-end bond tau = F / (2 (w + t) engage); ear root s = 6 F (ear/2) / (w_ear h^2) + F / (w_ear h); collar bond tau = T / (2 pi r^2 h) + F / (pi d h), h_req at MS 0; anchor tau = F / (len_y pi d_spar / 4) vs peel x bond allowable

nodes.title: Brace strip 10 x 2 against 10 x 3 (CR-C4-16), recommended design
nodes.equation: for t in (10 x 3, 10 x 2): sep_op (both quarters, nominal E/G); G2 brace force from the FE (limit, both quarters) x sf x fit vs Pcr = pi^2 E w t^3 / (12 L^2); mass of four braces = 4 rho w t L_mean; CR-B1-18 edge rounding of the 10 x 2 (both 2 mm edges full round, r = t/2): A and I_weak lose 2 (2 r^2 - pi r^2 / 2) and 2 (r (2r)^3 / 12 - pi r^4 / 8), Pcr scales with I; tape fairing = 4 x areal x perimeter (2 w + pi t) x 1.5 overlap x L_mean

nodes.title: Fin face with the D5 shoe cheeks extended (CR-C4-30), recommended design
nodes.equation: CALC-C4-D3-STATIC envelope re-run on a 36 x 30 fin mesh with the rigid D5 shoe region x >= tip_clear_x, |z| >= z0_prop instead of ASM-C4-SHOE-Z0; reports the face, strip and collar margins and the face stress with the cheeks as drawn on the same mesh

nodes.title: Motor mount on the tube end with the 7 deg tangential cant
nodes.equation: t = (-z_st, y_fin)/|.| (motor-circle tangent); F = T (-cos c, sin c t_y, sin c t_z) at r = (x_prop - x_tube, 0, z_st - L_tube/2) from the tube end; side = T sin c; axial = T sin c |t_z|; twist about the tube = |r_x| T sin c |t_y| + Q sin c |t_z|; rocking = |r x F| in x-y (worst sign) + Q cos c; design = limit x sf x fit x prt; slip-clamp use = sqrt((F_ax,d / (T_slip / r))^2 + ((M_tw,d + M_C1,ult fit prt) / T_slip)^2) (C1's mount moment taken wholly about the tube: conservative); G3 set-down (CR-C1-24): axial push F_g3 on the lip cap, bearing on the tube-wall annulus s = F_g3 jf / (pi/4 (od^2 - id^2)); rocking F_g3 |x_motor - x_tube|, x_motor = x_face - l_motor/2; rocking envelope = max(H2c, G3)

nodes.title: Through-core block on D3's geometry (bosses not credited for strength)
nodes.equation: as CALC-C4-BLOCK with h = core depth at the tube (z_upper - z_lower at x_t): tube bore s = 6M/(d h^2) + F/(d h); shear-out tau = (1.5 M / h)/(e h), e = (W - d)/2; spar bore s = 6M/(d W^2) + F/(d W); web s = 6M/(W h^2), tau = M/(0.21 W h^2); bond torsion tau = 2 My sf fit prt/(pi d^2 W); R5 (D-68): the four vertical edges rounded R (r_e): the shear-out planes are tangent to the bore (|x - x_t| = d/2) and the rounds lie at |x - x_t| >= d/2 + wall - R, so they are untouched while R <= wall; the diagonal ligament bore -> rounded corner = |c| + R - d/2, c = (d/2 + wall - R, W/2 - R), against the least ligament min(wall, (W - d)/2)

nodes.title: Fins mass, recommended design (D3's CAD corrected to two layers, the 0.21 m half height and the brace strip as drawn)
nodes.equation: half-fin area A(hh) = integral over x_le..x_te of (z_top(x) - z_skin(x)), z_top linear from the collar top to hh, 2 upper + 2 lower; boards = (areal + adh) [lay_rec A(hh) - lay_b A(hh_b)]; braces = rho_cf w (t - t_b) sum of the four lengths (ear to anchor); (lay_b, hh_b, t_b) = CL-D3-MASS basis; total = CL-D3-MASS + boards + braces

nodes.title: Ultimate proof of one TEST-ARTICLE fin quarter (not a flight fin; CR-H1-17)
nodes.procedure: Test article built with flight processes but never flown: one LOWER quarter (it carries G3 and the longer free tube) = one 0.21 m half-fin cut from the flight board batch (two 4.8 mm layers laminated), CF 22 x 20 tube offcut 0.20 m, PETG through-core block (R 3 mm vertical edges) bonded on a 0.15 m spar offcut in a 0.15 m core offcut, plug, station collar as drawn (13 mm), CF 10 x 2 brace 0.16 m with anchor saddle on the same spar offcut, CF 10 x 1 edge strips x 2 with 2.5 mm CF pins at 15 mm, strip tails bonded in the collar tongue (D-70 inspection), R5 ASA mount (cheeks 17 mm) with a dummy motor (steel slug at the motor CG, M3 x 8 into the plate), D5 shoe AS DRAWN (legs 7 mm, 8 mm cheeks over both strip ends, CR-C4-36), LE fillet LEFT UNBONDED and the ROOT FILLET LEFT OFF (primary path only, CR-C2-12), 30 min epoxy as in BUILD. Steps, each held 30 s, loads at 1.5 x limit through a hand-held spring scale or hung weights: (1) L4 at the C1 ground point 56 N along + 59 N across (C5 3-D side load, D-65), both senses; (2) G2 76 N lateral at the tube end, both senses; (3) G3 35 N on the dummy can toward the wing. Pass: no crack, face wrinkle, strip lift, pin push-out or bond-line movement (witness lines on collar, strip ends, brace ends, anchor); foot deflection at 1.0 x L4 <= 1.2 x CL-C4-D3-FOOT-DEFL. Then load step (1) to failure and record the load and the failed part. If step (1) fails below 1.5 x, fit the extended cheeks (CR-C4-30, |z| 0.171 m) on a second article and repeat. Flight fins get a 1.0 x limit L4 hand check only.

nodes.title: Mount rocking stiffness on the bench
nodes.procedure: Mount with motor clamped on a 60 mm tube stub held in a vice; 0.5 kg over a pulley at the prop nut, sideways (y) and fore-aft (z); dial gauges at the motor can top and at the collar; theta = (d_can - d_collar) / spacing; k = F a / theta. Pass: k >= the CL-C4-D3-MOUNT-K-REQ value in both directions.

nodes.title: Three-point bend of the US-stock 22 x 20 tube (I1 buys, H1 runs)
nodes.procedure: Span 0.80 m on two 22 mm dowels, load at centre in 0.5 kg steps to 4 kg, dial gauge to 0.01 mm; E = F L^3 / (48 I delta) with I = 3.645e-9 m4. Pass band for the recommended design: E >= 70 GPa.

nodes.title: Torsion of the same tube
nodes.procedure: Clamp 0.40 m of tube in two printed V-blocks at one end, 0.30 m lever arm at the other, 0.5-2 kg, measure twist with a laser pointer on a wall 3 m away; G = T L / (J theta), J = 7.29e-9 m4.

nodes.title: Tap test of one fin quarter (tube + block + half-fin + motor + prop + brace)
nodes.procedure: Block clamped in a vice via a core offcut; tap the motor bell in y and x; phone accelerometer or FC raw IMU at 1 kHz; FFT peaks vs 1P/2P at hover, cruise, max.

nodes.title: Foam-board face coupon
nodes.procedure: Three 50 x 300 mm strips per layer count, four-point bend, span 250 mm, load to failure: face allowable and D. Weigh 0.1 m2 for the areal mass.

nodes.title: Block proof in a core offcut
nodes.procedure: Block bonded on a spar stub in a 0.15 m core offcut; 0.30 m tube in the bore; hang 18 kg at 0.17 m lever (30 N m > design 20.3 N m) for 1 min; no creak, no bond line crack.

nodes.title: Bifilar swing of one prop
nodes.procedure: Two 0.5 m threads at the blade tips; period of 20 swings; I = m g d^2 T^2 / (16 pi^2 L).

nodes.title: IIW fatigue recommendations: hot-spot stress
nodes.where: Hobbacher, IIW doc. XIII-2460-13, 2016, sec. 2.2.3: surface stress read at 0.4 t and 1.0 t from the discontinuity, sigma_hs = 1.67 s(0.4t) - 0.67 s(1.0t)
reasons: value never compared with the source (no 'checked' date)

nodes.title: Roache: grid convergence index
nodes.where: Roache, J. Fluids Eng. 116 (1994) 405; Fs = 1.25 for three grids
reasons: value never compared with the source (no 'checked' date)

nodes.title: SU2 v8.5.0 ELASTICITY solver
nodes.where: linear elasticity, hex8 full integration, MARKER_LOAD = traction x area, FEA_FILENAME materials
reasons: value never compared with the source (no 'checked' date)

nodes.title: Tube wall + LE fillet zone modulus 3 GPa
nodes.text: Isotropic 3 GPa (nu 0.35) for the zone between the square bar face and the board LE (tube wall + epoxy fillet)
nodes.basis: Stands in for the shell model's rigid LE link: 100x stiffer in shear than the paper faces over 5.7 mm, adds 0.6 % to the tube's out-of-plane EI

nodes.title: D5 shoe region modulus 50 GPa (rigid)
nodes.text: Shoe legs, cheeks, glue and the board inside them as one stiff isotropic block (50 GPa), as the shell model's rigid shoe
nodes.basis: Same idealisation as fin_fe rigid_fin; real PETG legs (2 GPa, 0.8 mm) are softer, so the stress jump at the leg edge is not lower than in the real part

nodes.title: Station-collar tail tongue modulus 1 GPa (PETG, 45 % fill)
nodes.text: Isotropic 1 GPa (nu 0.35) for the printed tail tongue that replaces the board in the notched LE-top corner, from the tube surface to 40 mm aft, strip band + 1 mm deep; the CF edge strips run on over it to the tube
nodes.basis: PETG about 2.0 GPa solid x P:fin_detail.station_collar.tongue_fill 0.45 (perimeters carry more): 1 GPa. The R4 shell model had the strips ending on a rigid LE link; the first 3-D pass ended them at the board LE and put 26 MPa into the paper faces at the LE (artefact, removed by this zone)

nodes.title: Hot-spot read distances 0.4 t and 1.0 t, t = laminate 9.6 mm
nodes.text: Face stress at the shoe edge = linear surface extrapolation from 0.4 t and 1.0 t (IIW type a), t = two-board laminate thickness
nodes.basis: the peak at a rigid-insert edge is singular and grows with mesh refinement; the hot-spot value converges and is the structural stress the faces carry

nodes.title: As-designed station masses: motor 84.2 g, ESC 7.6 g, bullets 4 g
nodes.text: A3-R6a roll-up items: PRP-001 motor with its four M3 screws 84.2 g (params 81 g), PRP-002 stripped ESC 7.6 g (params 6.6 g), HRN-E03 phase bullets and short leads 4 g at 0.8 z_st on the tube
nodes.basis: team/A3/mass_model.csv and subsystems/propulsion/parts.csv (2026-11-10)

nodes.title: Benchmark tip load 10 N on the 100 x 10 x 10 mm two-modulus cantilever
nodes.text: Solver benchmark only (not aircraft data): steel/aluminium halves, 10 N tip shear
nodes.basis: closed-form reference exists (Euler-Bernoulli + Timoshenko shear)

nodes.title: SU2 ELASTICITY cantilever benchmark, 3 meshes
nodes.equation: tip deflection, 10 N tip shear on a 100 x 10 x 10 mm cantilever, E 70/210 GPa halves; reference d = P (7 L^3/(24 E1 I) + L^3/(24 E2 I)) + P L/(k G A), k = 5/6; meshes 2/4/8 elements through the depth (aspect 1); Richardson on the three; hex8 in-house on the same meshes

nodes.title: SU2 ELASTICITY on the fin quarter: solver trials against the hex8 direct solve
nodes.equation: upper quarter, mesh level 1 (8 mm / 2 mm, 71 k DOF), D5 shoe as drawn, L4 side part; SU2 v8 linear solvers available in this build (no PaStiX): CG + ILU(1) and restarted FGMRES(200) + ILU(2), 1500 it each, tol 1e-9; converged when log10 residual <= -6; field difference max |u_hex - u_su2| / max |u_hex|

nodes.title: Fin face hot-spot stress at the D5 shoe, SU2, 3 meshes
nodes.equation: hex8 direct solve (identical to SU2 ELASTICITY, CALC-C4-SIM-CODES); L4 limit: F = (-F_corner, +/- max(mu F_corner, F_C5), 0) at the C1 ground point through the rigid shoe (least-norm tractions on its outer faces, exact force and moment); face stress = in-plane principal |sigma| at the outer-face element centroids (sigma = D B u); hot-spot = 1.67 s(0.4t) - 0.67 s(1.0t) below each shoe lower edge, max over x, both faces, both senses; ultimate = sf x limit; MS = s_face / s_ult - 1; meshes 8 mm global, 2/1/0.5 mm in the tip box; Richardson r 2

nodes.title: Station modes, 3-D solid quarters with A3 masses, 3 meshes
nodes.equation: hex8 laminate (faces, cores, strips, shoe), CF tube as an orthotropic square bar (E_z I = E I_tube, G_xz J_sq = G J_tube), rigid ties to the tube root (k_root springs), tube end, collar (brace spring k = 1/(L/EA + 1/k_anchor) at the ear); station rigid body (A3 motor 84.2 g) on the mount springs; consistent mass; eigsh shift-invert; station mode = KE share >= 0.10; meshes 8/5.7/4 mm (bar and link at half size), Richardson r sqrt 2; separation = min |f/f_forcing - 1| over 1P/2P hover/cruise and 1P max

nodes.title: UN Manual of Tests and Criteria, section 38.3, test T.4 Shock (lithium batteries)
nodes.where: 38.3.4.4: small cells and batteries, half-sine 150 gn peak, 6 ms
nodes.note: every pack shipped as UN3480 must pass T.4; value not yet re-read against the current revision

nodes.title: Touchdown drift 0.3 m/s
nodes.text: Horizontal ground speed at touchdown in QLAND / QLOITER with GPS position hold, any direction
nodes.basis: ArduPilot position hold on a 2-3 kg multirotor typically holds < 0.3 m/s in 5 m/s wind; replace with the twin's landing logs (T-C5-DRIFT-LOG)
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Parked-stance factor 1.5
nodes.text: Factor on the overturning moment and on the friction demand before a parked, disarmed aircraft is allowed to stand
nodes.basis: same 1.5 as the structural ultimate factor; the parked case has no pilot to save it

nodes.title: Gust factor 1.4 over the mean
nodes.text: Peak gust / 10-min mean wind at 2 m height at RFS in the morning
nodes.basis: open-terrain gust factors 1.3-1.5 at 2 m; H3 measures it with the handheld anemometer (R-WIND-MEASURE)
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Lift coefficient lying flat 0.6
nodes.text: Largest lift coefficient of the wing lying flat on the ground, pod up, any wind direction
nodes.basis: flat plate at 0 deg with a reflexed section, ground effect and a small nose-up rest angle; 0.6 is above any value expected for alpha < 5 deg
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Prop blade half-depth 12 mm turned spanwise
nodes.text: Half the z extent of an 11 in prop blade at the hub region when the blade is turned spanwise
nodes.basis: APC 11x5.5MR hub ~ 10 mm thick, blade chord ~ 25 mm at 5.5 in pitch; measure (H1)
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Tube-end cap 5 mm
nodes.text: The motor mount / end cap stands 5 mm beyond the tube end
nodes.basis: A1 envelope note (transport.envelope_props_off_m: tube ends +/-0.21 plus ~5 mm mount caps)

nodes.title: Pack deceleration limit 100 g
nodes.text: Largest pack deceleration accepted in the survivable crash, applied through foam over the full fore face (no point load)
nodes.basis: UN 38.3 T.4 shock 150 gn on every shipped pack, / 1.5
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Pod nose wall 2 mm
nodes.text: Thickness of the pod nose skin ahead of the crush block
nodes.basis: foam board or printed shell (D2)

nodes.title: Pad friction on grass 0.5
nodes.text: Friction coefficient of the neoprene pad on mown RFS grass (parked-stance slide check)
nodes.basis: C1-R2 value for grass; C1 moved ASM-C1-FRICTION to the mat value 0.7 (CR-C5-09), so the grass case carries its own number; H1 spring-scale pull on grass
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Drop-test stroke guard 3 mm
nodes.text: Stroke that must remain unused at the end of the design drop (scatter of the XPS plateau)
nodes.basis: 10 % of the 32 mm stroke

nodes.title: Pre-D-47 bay, for the before / after comparison only
nodes.text: Edits that put A3's D-47 item list back to the R4 bay: pack centroid at x_pack, trim kit POD-008 moved by dx_kit, pitot socket POD-006 by dx_nose. Value [x_pack m, dx_kit m, dx_nose m]
nodes.basis: D-47 (CR-A3-22, CR-A1-43): pack -0.001 -> -0.022, bay 21 mm forward, nose 15 mm forward. Used only for CL-C5-D47-CG-RISE; every flying case uses A3's items as listed

nodes.title: CG cases and static tip-over on the fin-tip feet
nodes.equation: CG from A3 items (feet replaced by D5's mass at x = c + foot/2) ; flying cases: pack slid until x_cg = D-62 target / forward / aft limit (P:cg.*), pack 546 / 550 / 590 g (D-64), and each pack at its D-62 flight station (P:pack_x_per_pack_m, D2-R6 / D-64) ; h = c + foot - x_cg ; narrow(+z) = atan((z_pad - z_cg) / h), narrow(-z) = atan((z_pad + z_cg) / h) ; wide = atan(y_fin / h) ; residual thrust T = lam W along the body: tip at acos(lam z/R) - atan(h/z), R = hypot(z, h) ; lam_max(err) = R cos(err + atan(h/z)) / z ; corner bound: x = forward limit, z = top of the z range ; D-47 rise = h(550 g station) - h(pre-D-47 bay, ASM-C5-PRE-D47) ; +5 mm allowance: worst station case with h + 5 mm

nodes.title: Landing lean, drift allowance and parked-stance wind limits
nodes.equation: lean = atan(q S CD90 / (m g)), S = b c broadside or 4 fin_c fin_hh span-along-wind ; v_allow(phi) = sqrt(2 g (R - b_phi)(k^2 + R^2)) / b_phi, b_phi = z sin phi + h cos phi ; delta(v) = beta - phi(v_allow = v) ; beta_req = lean(5) + err + delta(v_td) ; V_tip = sqrt(2 m g z_arm / (h_cp rho S CD90)), h_cp = c/2 + foot ; V_slide = sqrt(2 mu m g / (rho S CD90)) ; V_park = min(V_tip, V_slide)/sqrt(SF) ; V_lift,flat = sqrt(2 m g / (rho S CL_flat))

nodes.title: Tilt-board tip-over angles
nodes.procedure: Built aircraft, props off, pack in (then pack slid to the forward stop, then pack out), on a 0.6 x 0.8 m plywood board faced with the landing-mat rubber, a 6 mm stop strip behind the pads on the hinge side. Raise the far edge slowly with a phone inclinometer on the board; record the angle when the far pads lift. Four directions (+z pod side, -z, +y, -y), 3 times each. Pass: pod side >= 30 deg and within 1.5 deg of CL-C5-TIPOVER-R1 (else re-measure the CG z).

nodes.title: Touchdown drift and spool-down from logs

Pass: 95th percentile ground speed <= 0.3 m/s; throttle out <= 0.71 hover within 0.5 s of contact.

nodes.title: Single-foot drop rig
nodes.procedure: A foot (shoe bonded on a 2-layer foam-board offcut clamped vertical) under a 0.65 kg sled on two guide rods; free drop 0.115 m onto plywood; phone or logger accelerometer on the sled. 3 drops, new cartridge each. Pass: stroke <= 35 mm (model 26 mm), sled peak <= 6.0 g (100 Hz filter), no shoe-bond crack. With the biased, pre-crushed cartridges (CR-C5-10, R3) use a 0.69 kg sled for an upper-foot cartridge and 0.61 kg for a lower one (quarter gate mass x bias). Run before the aircraft drop; cheap and repeatable.

nodes.title: Aircraft drop (= T-C1-FOOT-DROP), proposed foot
nodes.procedure: Complete aircraft, props off, LiPo replaced by a sandbag of the weighed pack mass (ballast to 2.6 kg), FC on a small 2S pack logging IMU at >= 1 kHz. Quick-release hook over plywood. (1) Level, 0.115 m pad-to-floor, x2, new cartridges each: pass CG peak <= 6.0 g (100 Hz low-pass), every stroke <= 35 mm, each pair's stroke within 3 mm of the model (the R3 bias leaves the upper pair ~3 mm deeper by design). (2) Pitch 4 deg both ways and roll 8 deg, at 0.098 m (CL-C5-TEST-TILT-H): pass when each pair's stroke is within 3 mm of the model re-run at the measured height and tilt, and the wing TE stays clear except the wingtip corner cap. The model then carries the design case (1.5 m/s with 2/3 W lift). After every drop: shoe bonds, fin tips, tube block and pod bond checked.

nodes.title: Crush block ahead of the pack (5 m/s nose-in), D-62 bay (nose -0.140 m), D-64 packs
nodes.equation: per weighed pack mass m (546 / 551 / 590 g, D-64) at its D-62 station x_p (flight-card mark) and at the C5 trim to the D-62 target: F = min(n_pack m g, sigma A_bay) ; KE = m v^2 / 2 ; eff = eps_d - eps_y / 2 ; nose wall inside face x_n = x_le + t_nose ; block A L_A = nose_block_l_m ; forward stop (t_stop, h_stop, w = fwd_stop_m) aft face x_s = x_n + L_A + t_stop ; block B fills x_s .. pack fore face behind a t_sp spreader ; capacities add: gap_B needed = t_sp + max(0, KE - F_A eff L_A) / (F eff), F_A = min(F, sigma A_stop) ; full-section stop A_stop = A_bay ; D2's stop as drawn A_stop = h_stop w ; margin = (x_p - L_pack/2 - x_s) - gap_B needed ; most forward station x_fwd_max = x_p - margin ; block A (1 mm epoxy bond since D-47) gets no crush credit ; crush-stack station (A3/A1 nose stack blk_min from the pod LE) x_stack = x_le + blk_min + L_pack/2, stack margin = x_stack - x_fwd_max ; extension = max(0, -worst margin) ; box x slack = box_x - 2 wall - (envelope_x + extension)
