nodes.title: 3-D sim: worst stroke, 10 deg envelope, gate mass
nodes.text: Largest foot stroke in the design landing (sink requirements.landing_sink_ms, lift 2/3 W) over every touchdown tilt <= 10 deg in any direction (2.5 deg x 24 azimuths), at the 2.6 kg gate mass (A3-R6a inertia scaled), CG at the D-62 target
nodes.basis: sim/out/sim3d.json (sim/landing_sim3d.py C5-R6, 1290 s run, sink 1.2 m/s); dt 40 us, dt ladder to 5 us changes it by 0.010 mm

nodes.title: 3-D sim: worst stroke, pitch-only or roll-only
nodes.text: As ASM-C5-SIM3D-STROKE, touchdown tilt about one stance axis only (the planar model's cases)
nodes.basis: sim/out/sim3d.json (sim/landing_sim3d.py C5-R6, 1290 s run, sink 1.2 m/s)

nodes.title: 3-D sim: worst stroke at the A3 basic mass
nodes.text: As ASM-C5-SIM3D-STROKE at the as-designed A3-R6a basic mass 2.322 kg
nodes.basis: sim/out/sim3d.json (sim/landing_sim3d.py C5-R6, 1290 s run, sink 1.2 m/s)

nodes.title: 3-D sim: tilt that uses up the stroke
nodes.text: Smallest touchdown tilt magnitude (2.5 deg steps, any direction, design sink, gate mass) at which a foot passes the usable stroke; when no case inside the 10 deg envelope bottoms, the largest tilt simulated (10 deg)
nodes.basis: sim/out/sim3d.json (sim/landing_sim3d.py C5-R6, 1290 s run, sink 1.2 m/s)

nodes.title: 3-D sim: sink speed limit at 10 deg
nodes.text: Largest sink speed (0.1 m/s steps, 0.8-1.3) at which a 10 deg touchdown in any of 24 directions stays inside the usable stroke, gate mass
nodes.basis: sim/out/sink_sweep.json (sim/sink_sweep.py, C5-R6)

nodes.title: 3-D sim: peak load factor, level, A3 basic mass
nodes.text: Peak crusher force on the airframe / weight, level design landing at the as-designed A3-R6a basic mass with the 550 g pack
nodes.basis: sim/out/sim3d.json (sim/landing_sim3d.py C5-R6, 1290 s run, sink 1.2 m/s)

nodes.title: 3-D sim: peak load factor, level, lightest flying mass
nodes.text: As ASM-C5-SIM3D-N at A3-R6a basic with the D-64 546 g pack (the lightest flying mass; the crush plateau is fixed, so n rises as the mass falls)
nodes.basis: sim/out/sim3d.json (sim/landing_sim3d.py C5-R6, 1290 s run, sink 1.2 m/s); m = 2.3415 kg

nodes.title: 3-D sim: peak load factor anywhere in the envelope, lightest mass
nodes.text: Largest CG load factor over the whole 10 deg envelope at the lightest mass (tilted cases included)
nodes.basis: sim/out/sim3d.json (sim/landing_sim3d.py C5-R6, 1290 s run, sink 1.2 m/s)

nodes.title: 3-D sim: sustained foot side load at the design sink
nodes.text: Largest transverse (side) load on one foot, 1 ms filtered, over every design-envelope case (4 masses), every sink-sweep row at or below the design sink and every drift-sweep row (0.3 m/s drift, 10 deg) that stays inside the usable stroke, mu 0.7
nodes.basis: sim/out/sim3d.json (sim/landing_sim3d.py C5-R6, 1290 s run, sink 1.2 m/s) + sim/out/drift_sweep.json; without drift 39.31 N; sink sweep to 1.3 m/s 39.31 N; the unfiltered peak includes the 0.2 ms piston-mass impact on the pad (42.3 N)

nodes.title: Design foot side load (limit), D-65 basis rounded up to cover drift
nodes.text: Limit side load per foot that D5, C4/D3 and C1 design to (CHANGE-LOG D-65, CR-C5-16)
nodes.basis: C5-S1 6-DOF 39.30 N (1.5 m/s envelope + sink sweep, no drift) adopted by D-65; C5-R6 adds the 0.3 m/s drift landings, 39.44 N (+0.4 %, sim/out/drift_sweep.json), so C5 rounds the basis up to 39.5 N (ultimate 59.25 N; was 39.3 / 59.0, CR-C5-16 update). Held fixed between runs so the downstream roles do not drift; CL-C5-SIM3D-SIDE-12 checks every run against it

nodes.title: 3-D sim: sustained foot side load, pad mu 0.5
nodes.text: As ASM-C5-SIM3D-SIDE over the gate-mass 10 deg envelope with a pad face of mu 0.5 on the landing mat
nodes.basis: sim/out/sim3d.json (sim/landing_sim3d.py C5-R6, 1290 s run, sink 1.2 m/s); governing single case re-run in side_check.py: 29.1 N

nodes.title: 3-D sim: wingtip strike onset tilt
nodes.text: Smallest touchdown tilt (design sink, any direction, any mass) at which the wingtip TE corner reaches the ground
nodes.basis: sim/out/sim3d.json (sim/landing_sim3d.py C5-R6, 1290 s run, sink 1.2 m/s) (wingtip contact itself not modelled: the corner cap GER-007 takes it)

nodes.title: 3-D sim: broadside landing wind limit
nodes.text: Largest wind (0.5 m/s steps) for which a touchdown tilted by the hover lean + 10 deg toward the narrow pod-side pad line, drifting 0.3 m/s toward it, does not tip; wind gone at touchdown (lull), sink 0.5 m/s and the design sink, A3 basic mass
nodes.basis: sim/out/sim3d.json (sim/landing_sim3d.py C5-R6, 1290 s run, sink 1.2 m/s)

nodes.title: 3-D sim: span-into-wind landing wind limit
nodes.text: As ASM-C5-SIM3D-V-BROADSIDE, lean and error toward a wide (fin) pad line
nodes.basis: sim/out/sim3d.json (sim/landing_sim3d.py C5-R6, 1290 s run, sink 1.2 m/s) (12 m/s is the top of the sweep)

nodes.title: 3-D sim: drift cases that tip
nodes.text: Number of the 128 drift cases (0.3 m/s, 8 directions x 8 tilts of 10 deg x 2 sinks) that tip over
nodes.basis: sim/out/sim3d.json (sim/landing_sim3d.py C5-R6, 1290 s run, sink 1.2 m/s)

nodes.title: 3-D sim: sink speed limit at 10 deg with 0.3 m/s drift
nodes.text: Largest sink speed (0.1 m/s steps) at which a 10 deg touchdown (8 attitudes) drifting 0.3 m/s in 8 directions stays inside the usable stroke, gate mass
nodes.basis: sim/out/drift_sweep.json (sim/drift_sweep.py, C5-R6): 1.2 m/s gives 38.1 mm at the gate, 36.9 mm at A3 predicted

nodes.title: 3-D sim: free-drop height for the 10 deg corner drop
nodes.text: Largest pad-to-floor free-drop height (no rotor lift, 5 mm steps) at which a 10 deg touchdown in any of 24 directions stays inside the usable stroke, gate mass
nodes.basis: sim/out/test_height.json (sim/test_height.py, C5-R6): 50 mm gives 34.1 mm, 55 mm 37.1 mm

nodes.title: Pilot-commanded descent speed limit C5 asks of F4
nodes.text: Q_PILOT_SPD_DN that keeps a drifting 10 deg touchdown inside the stroke with one 0.1 m/s step in hand
nodes.basis: CR-C5-23 (C5-R6); F4 holds Q_PILOT_SPD_DN <= 1.2 m/s today (D-65); replace with F4 value

nodes.title: 3-D sim: input snapshot
nodes.text: Input values the simulation ran with, in the order of the CALC-C5-SIM-STALE inputs
nodes.basis: sim/out/sim3d.json (sim/landing_sim3d.py C5-R6, 1290 s run, sink 1.2 m/s)

nodes.title: Shoe FEA (as-drawn D5-R5): von Mises per newton of lip reaction
nodes.text: Governing von Mises stress in the as-drawn printed shoe GER-001 (wall 1.6, rim 2.4, inside corner R 0.4 mm, engagement 20 mm) per newton of tine lip reaction at the sleeve end: case +y, zone rim
nodes.basis: sim/out/fea_shoe.json (C5-S1: sim/fea_shoe.py + SU2 8.5 ELASTICITY, trilinear hexahedra, 3 levels h 0.4 / 0.32 / 0.267 mm, Richardson; verification strip vs beam theory)

nodes.title: Shoe FEA (as-drawn): lip reaction per newton of side load
nodes.text: D5's tine lever R / F = (a + e) / (e + eps_y L_cart) for the as-drawn stack

nodes.title: Shoe side load to failure
nodes.procedure: Two shoes as D5 builds them (R6: walls 1.2, rim 2.8, R 1.0 inside fillets, 25 mm engagement, layers along the sleeve axis) bonded on stepped foam-board offcuts (as T-D5-PROOF), insert pushed 4.5 mm in; load the pad sideways along +y on one, +z on the other, in 5 N steps to failure; record the load and where it cracks (rim, window end, roof, fin TE). nodes.title: Motor to mount: 4 x M3x8 into the motor base, incl. the 7 deg cant side load
nodes.equation: P = T/(K d); head bearing = P / (pi/4 (dh^2 - dhole^2)); cant side moment M_s = T_lim sin(cant) arm sf; screw tension F_t = ff (F/4 + (M + M_s)/s_min); separation RF = P / F_t; thread strip = 0.5 pi d e tau_Al with e = L_screw - plate (R3 canted plate, uniform grip)

nodes.title: Motor screws on the 7 deg canted plate: engagement and head seating
nodes.equation: R3 (D3): whole plate canted, faces parallel to the motor face, holes drilled square to the face -> engagement = L - plate at every hole; for record, the R2 layout (flat plate, canted 2 mm pads) would give L - (2.5 + 2 + tan(cant) max|t . hole|) and allow a screw lean of only atan((d_hole - d)/4.5 mm) against the cant

nodes.title: Mount collar on the tube under the 7 deg cant side force
nodes.equation: side S = T_lim sin(cant) along t = x_hat x r_hat = (0, -z/r, y/r); tube torsion Mz = S z/r (x_tube - x_prop); axial along the tube S y/r; design x sf ff pf; slip capacity Ts (torsion), Ts/(od/2) (axial, same friction)

nodes.title: Motor-mount slit collar: M3x16 + nyloc, rocking under the prop-nut torque
nodes.equation: protrusion = L - (2 ear + slit + nw wt); needed nyloc h + n p; clamp N = Ts/(mu pi r), bolt torque = K N d; rocking bearing p = 6 M/(od grip^2), M = Tprop sf ff pf; tube hoop = p r / t

nodes.title: Power frame PWR-006 on 4 x M3x18 PA66 into brass heat-set inserts (E-PWR-03)
nodes.equation: e = L - stack >= kmin d (D-41), e <= insert length, bore >= e + 0.5 mm; preload P = T/(K d); install von Mises = sqrt((P/As)^2 + 3 (16 share T/(pi d3^3))^2), As = pi/4 ((d2+d3)/2)^2; unplug design k = sf ff pf: tension per screw F_t = k F a/(2 s), shear V = k F; tension RF = s_pa As/(P + F_t); slip RF = 4 mu P / V (and at 50 % preload after nylon creep); if it slips the spacer bends as a guided column: M = (V/4) L_sp/2, sigma = M (OD/2)/I_tube; insert RF = pull-out / max(P + F_t, Fc ff pf)

nodes.title: Tube-in-block, block-on-spar and station-collar bonds
nodes.equation: tau = T / (2 pi r^2 L), T = T_ult ff pf; spar OD = tube OD (22 mm); tube bore L = core + 2 bosses; collar (CR-C4-23): T_lim = max(C1 J-FINHALF section torsion, C4 FE collar torsion); tau = T_lim sf ff pf / (2 pi r^2 h) + F_brace pf / (pi d h) (F_brace already x 1.5 x 1.15); h_req = (T/(2 pi r^2) + F/(pi d)) / tau; D-70 condition: 12 mm only at tau_c = 0.5 x 4.1 MPa coupon mean

nodes.title: Edge-strip anchorage in the station collar and strip-to-board shear flow
nodes.equation: C4 R3 FE (CR-C4-23): F = strip force per face at the collar end, design; anchor tau = F/(n w (tail - gap)); L_req = F/(2 w tau); tail net section sigma = F / A_net vs PETG; paper face if unpinned: tau = q_lim sf ff pf / w vs kd tau_board; pins carry the whole shear flow: P = C4 pin force at the drawn pitch, shear P/(pi d^2/4), bending (pin loaded at the strip, reacted at the board mid-plane, bound) 32 P (n tb + t)/2 / (pi d^3); at another pitch P' = P pitch'/pitch; D-70 (drawn since D3-R5): d = d' = 2.5 mm at 15 mm; fallback d_alt 2 mm at pitch_alt; max pitch for the drawn d = pitch x RF(d), and for d_alt likewise; strip bearing P'/(d' t) vs CF bearing; strip net section at the pin F/((w - d') t) vs CF

nodes.title: Brace ends in their slots and the anchor saddle on the spar
nodes.equation: F_d = F (C4 R3, incl. 1.5 x 1.15) x pf; end bond tau = F_d / (2 (w+t) e); anchor saddle contact = len_y x (pi d_spar / 4) (90 deg wrap, C4 method), sigma = F_d / A vs peel

nodes.title: Through-core block in its core pocket with R 3 mm vertical edges (D-68)
nodes.equation: plan perimeter square 2 (Lx + w), rounded 2 (Lx + w) - 8 r + 2 pi r (wall bond area scales with it); a square-cut pocket leaves (sqrt 2 - 1) r of void on each corner diagonal; a pocket radius R_p seats the block with a corner gap (sqrt 2 - 1)(R_p - r) for R_p >= r (R_p < r rides on the corners), so r <= R_p <= r + bl/(sqrt 2 - 1); bead = nb x Lx of leg^2/2 section at gcc, two blocks

nodes.title: Bounding estimate: C4's frozen R4 fin joint loads scaled to C1's D-65 torsion
nodes.equation: k = C1 wing-plane half-fin torsion now / the C4 FE wing-plane torsion its R4 set was solved at (C4 checked them equal then, CL-C4-D3-SEC-T-VS-C1); the foot side load drives both the torsion and the strip couple, so strip force, pin force and the collar-tail demand scale with k (linear FE): F' = k F, RF' = RF / k, pitch_max' = pitch_max / k, L_req' = k L_req, tail net area needed = k A_net / RF_tail; H1 frame >= 1.25 F'. Estimate only, replaced by C4's re-run

nodes.title: Foot shoe and fin root bonds at the C6 allowables
nodes.equation: foot shoe (CR-D5-24): D5 now sizes at the C6 allowable kd tau_board, so RF = SF_D5; design load = kd tau A / SF; fin root RF = RF_D3 x (C6 XPS allowable / D3's 0.25 MPa) = RF_D3 kd; with leg l': x l'(n tb + l') / (l (n tb + l)) (fillet couple capacity, CALC-D3-ROOT)

nodes.title: Pod joint allowables owned by C6 (CR-C3-05) and C3's pod joints re-checked
nodes.equation: C6 design allowable = kd x typical; C3 pod bond uses sigma_a = ASM-D2-XPS-ALLOW <= C6 and tau_a = min(ASM-C3-XPS-SHEAR, ASM-D5-BOND-TAU) = C6, so RF = 1/R (conservative); tray flat RF = kd f_b / sigma; floor glue RF = kd tau_b / sigma, with a fillet the glue width t -> t + leg; hatch tab RF = HL tension / demand

nodes.title: Servo frame and control horn: minimum bond area into XPS
nodes.equation: F = Mh/arm (V_D/V_B2)^2 sf ff pf, V_D = requirements.vd_ms 27.2 m/s (D-50: VD held by the fixed-wing throttle cap; full deflection at VD is conservative vs F4's schedule, D-29); A_min = F / (kd sigma_XPS)

nodes.title: Foot piston snap hook: minimum finger length
nodes.equation: cantilever snap fit eps = 1.5 t y / L^2  ->  L_min = sqrt(1.5 t y / eps)

nodes.title: Motor-mount slip clamp: the D-23 fuse
nodes.equation: side force at the can that turns the collar F = T / (x_tube - x_can_mid); root moment = F z_m (brace ignored: conservative); hold ratio = T / (M_mount,ult ff pf); bolt clamp N = T / (mu pi r)

nodes.title: Prop plane to the nearest structure behind it
nodes.equation: hub on the canted axis: x_prop = x_face - stack cos(cant) (D-51); gap = collar front - prop plane = face_ahead + stack cos(cant); required 0.14 D (B4 CR-B4-04). Tip over the tube (disc mid-plane, blade tip straight toward the wing, -z): x_tip = x_prop - sense tan(cant) (y_m / r_m) D/2; tip gap = (x_t - od/2) - x_tip (B4 CL-B4-GAP-TUBE does the same on its geometry)

nodes.title: Motor screw thread engagement on the 7 deg canted plate
nodes.equation: R3 canted plate (front and back faces both on the cant plane): engagement = L_screw - t_plate at every hole; for comparison the R2 flat plate + canted pads would give L - (t + tan(cant) max|t.hole|)

nodes.title: Station collar height, tongue fit and two-face tail length
nodes.equation: R4 (D-48): collar ratio = h / h_req (C4-R3 envelope torsion + brace shear) and h / h_req_c6 (C6, max of C1 and C4 torsion + brace shear); tongue fit = h - (w / cos e + tongue depth), e = top-edge slope from the collar top (L/2 - grip - gap) at the LE (x_t + od/2 + gap) to the half height at the step front (te - sq); strip embedment = tail - LE gap, ratio = embedment / embed_req (C6, two faces bonded: tongue + wall)

nodes.title: Strap eye on the block boss (H1 restrained run)
nodes.equation: worst ligament e = min(L - yh - d/2, (h - d)/2); shear-out capacity 2 e t tau; RF = capacity / (F sf pf)

nodes.title: Stepped foot tip for D5's shoe
nodes.equation: R4 (D-54): square-tip ratio = D3 tip length / D5 step length (te - x_step D5); step mismatch = max(|x_sq - x_d5|, |z_step - z_d5|); tip edge width = n t_board

nodes.title: ESC pad inside the hover slipstream
nodes.equation: pad radial extent from the motor axis r = |z_m - z_pad| -/+ h/2 inside [hub R, wash R]

nodes.title: Half-fin root fillet joint, foot side load
nodes.equation: R5 (D-65): M = share S_side,ult pf h with the design foot side load (C1 max of friction and C5's 3-D sim, ultimate; was mu F_foot). R4 fillet zones (fins.py): full leg over the last L_eff of BONDED root from the TE, leg_aft aft of the hinge x_h = c (1 - ef), the lower root skips the link slot x_h +/- slot (CR-D6-04). M_cap = sigma_xps sum(leg_i (t_fin + leg_i) L_i); governing = the root whose full zone carries the least; rf_allow = rf kd (C6 allowable, CR-C6-24)

nodes.title: Brace geometry, D3 R3
nodes.equation: ear point (x_t, y_f - r_collar - ear/2, z_ear_mid = L_tube/2 - grip - gap - ear_h/2), anchor (x_s, y_a, z_skin + proud/2); Pcr = pi^2 E (w t^3/12) / L^2 (pinned, thin axis); Pcr ratio = Pcr / F_design (C4); lateral axial stiffness ky = E w t (dy/L)^2 / L (information). nodes.title: Foot stack, fin step and sizes (landing.py geometry())
nodes.equation: x_g = c + foot ; flange = x_g - pad - t_fl ; rim end = flange - stroke ; tine open = rim end - engage ; back wall = open - stroke - 1 mm ; L_cart = flange - back wall ; sections: cartridge + 2 cf -> tine + 2 w -> sleeve + 2 cs + 2 w ; sleeve roof = z_outer - lip, floor = roof - sleeve z ; fin step z = floor - glue, x = back wall - glue ; z_eff = z_outer - r ; TE clear = foot - stroke

nodes.title: Constant-force crush, biased cartridges (type U upper, type L lower)
nodes.equation: A_U = fy fz ; A_L = A_U - pi d^2/4 ; F_U,L = sigma A ; F_mean = (F_U + F_L)/2 ; bias = F_U / F_mean ; level: 4 F_mean (s - eps_y L/2) = m v^2/2 + (1 - lam) m g s ; n = 4 k F_mean / (m g) ; usable = s_max - guard >= C5 pair-first stroke ; normal set = (m v_n^2/2 - 4 F_mean eps_e L/2) / (4 F_mean) ; no-set sink = sqrt(2 E_el / m) ; strain = (pre + s_max) / (L + pre) (pre-crush counted) ; cut = (L + pre) / n_seg ; mark margin = s_max - guard - mark - s_pair ; landings = mark / set ; mean error = F_mean / F_C5 - 1

nodes.title: Narrow-axis tip-over about the pad edges, z_cg subtracted (CR-C5-01)
nodes.equation: h = c + foot - x_cg ; narrow = atan((z_eff - z_cg) / h) ; worst = atan((z_eff - z_cg,max) / (c + foot - x_cg,min)) ; wide = atan(y_fin / h)

nodes.title: Landing mass from the CAD body volumes
nodes.equation: m = rho V (V = landing.volume(bodies)) ; shoe + epoxy 0.35 g ; cartridge + CA 0.05 g ; cap + tape ; total = 2 upper feet + 2 lower feet + 2 caps

nodes.title: Flange overhang bending at the ultimate upper-foot load on its edge
nodes.equation: F = max(D5 upper ult, C1 foot-to-fin ult, C1 L1 upper-foot ult (CR-C1-34)) ; M = F a ; sigma = 6 M / (b t^2) ; SF = allow / sigma

nodes.title: Shoe-to-half-fin bond at the printed/bonded design load
nodes.equation: A = floor on the step edge (L t_fin) + legs 2 L d + back wall on the step front t_fin h_step + collar cheeks on the strip ends 2 l (w_strip + 2 mm) ; design = max(F, F_c1, F_c1u) ff ; allow = tau kd (C6) ; RF = allow A / design

nodes.title: Side load at the pad: shoe sleeve end by FEA, tine bending by beam
nodes.equation: F = 1.5 F_side (C5 3-D sim, mu 0.7, D-65) ; sleeve end: sigma = k_FEA F (D5 FEA of the drawn shoe, lever R = F (a + e) / (e + s0), s0 = eps_y L_cart) ; RF = allow / sigma ; R5 beam kept for information: M = R b / 12 over the rim ; tine at the rim: M = F a on the windowed, chamfered section

nodes.title: Cartridge crush coupon, both types
nodes.procedure: Pre-crush every segment 1 mm (drill-press stop). Crush 3 type-U and 3 type-L cartridge pairs in a printed piston + shoe on the drill press over the H1 load cell, 40 mm at < 10 mm/s; record force every 2 mm. Pass (C5-R3, mean force 5-35 mm): U 38.2-40.2 N, L 34.6-36.3 N, ratio U/L 1.09-1.14, peak <= 1.05 x plateau, flat to 40 mm. Off target: change section_y_m (both types) by the force ratio, or the bore tube (ratio), and re-run feet_calc.py.

nodes.title: Pad slide on a tilt board
nodes.procedure: Foot with pad, 0.65 kg on it, on a board faced with concrete paver / asphalt shingle / the landing mat; tilt until it slides; mu = tan(angle). Pass >= 0.7 dry.

nodes.title: Timed foot-insert swap
nodes.procedure: One student, field kit only, swap a crushed insert for a spare on the built aircraft; pass <= 10 min.

nodes.title: Shoe bond and flange proof load
nodes.procedure: Shoe bonded (24 h) on a stepped two-layer foam-board offcut with strip ends; load the pad along x to 96 N (C1 upper-foot ult 66.6 N x 1.4375) through a 10 mm steel block at the pad edge; hold 3 s. Pass: no bond crack, no flange crack.

nodes.title: Side load at the pad
nodes.procedure: Two R6 shoes bonded on stepped offcuts (as T-D5-PROOF), printed as flown (layers stacked along the sleeve axis), insert pushed 5 mm in; 60 N (>= C5's 59.0 N ult, D-65) at the pad sideways along +y on one, +z on the other, held 3 s; pass: no crack at the rim, window or roof, insert still slides. Then C5's T-C5-SHOE-SIDE-FAIL on the same specimens.

nodes.title: Elevon hinge moment per servo (two panels)
nodes.equation: H = Ch_max (delta/25) q c^2 (b_in + b_out), q = rho V^2 / 2

nodes.title: Servo-to-elevon four-bar: throw, ratio, torque factor
nodes.equation: |P(theta) - Q(delta)| = L0; k(theta) = d delta / d theta; worst servo torque / H25 = max over travel of (delta/25) k

nodes.title: Servo torque required at the output vs rating
nodes.equation: T = SF x H x torque_factor (four-bar, worst point); kgf cm = N m / g x 100

nodes.title: Pushrod force, buckling and horn bond area
nodes.equation: F = H / (r_h sin phi) worst; Pcr = pi^2 E I / L^2; A_min = F sf ff pf / (kd sigma_XPS)

nodes.title: Clearances through the full mechanical travel
nodes.equation: min over delta in [-stop, stop] of the gaps: bridge rod to fin notch sides, bottom and the fixed-core skin; horn arm to the core lower skin; pushrod to the lower skin; clevis to the boss; horn plate to the clevis slot bottom

nodes.title: Surface free play, worst-case sum
nodes.equation: slop = backlash x k_neutral + (play_arm + play_horn) / r_h (rad -> deg)

nodes.title: Inter-panel rod lag, panel twist and elevon effectiveness loss
nodes.equation: rod: fixed-guided beam, d = F L^3 / (12 E I), F = H_out / r_b, lag = d / r_b; panel: uniform torque m from the drive point, tube over the first a L (GJ_h), skin + foam beyond (GJ_l): tip = m L^2 [(a - a^2/2)/GJ_h + (1-a)^2/(2 GJ_l)], mean = m L^2 [(a^2/2 - a^3/6 + (a - a^2/2)(1-a))/GJ_h + (1-a)^3/(3 GJ_l)] (a = 1: tip m L^2/2GJ, mean 2/3 tip); GJ = G_tube J_tube + 4 A^2 G_skin t / s (closed tape box) + G_xps c_e t^3 / 12; loss = mean lag / 25 deg

nodes.title: Bridge-rod choice: outboard effectiveness loss and mass per rod
nodes.equation: lag_alt = lag x (E d^4) / (E_alt d_alt^4) (same fixed-guided beam); loss_alt = loss + (lag_alt - lag) / 25 deg; m = pi d^2 / 4 x L_cut x rho

nodes.title: Servo frame bonded area and the area its load needs
nodes.equation: A = rim (Lx Ly - (Lx - 2r)(Ly - 2r)) + inboard wall Lx Hz + 2 end walls Ly Hz; Lx = ear span + 2 w, Ly = H + boss + t_arm + c + w (1.5 mm arm gap left out: conservative), Hz = W + c + w; F = T_stall / r_arm + T_stall / Lx; A_min = F sf ff pf / (kd sigma_XPS) (C6 method)

nodes.title: Packs travel outside the box
nodes.text: Flight packs ride in a LiPo bag (E2), not in the box; the aircraft in the box is the gate mass less one pack
nodes.basis: LiPo transport practice (E2 owns); keeps the loaded box under 6 kg

nodes.title: Design drop is flat on the floor
nodes.text: The 0.3 m sill drop is designed for a flat floor impact; side, end and corner impacts are checked by test only
nodes.basis: a box slipping off a sill lands on its floor or a bottom edge; edge drops rotate the box and load less (ISTA practice)
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Lid pillars stop the rebound before the upper tube ends reach the lid
nodes.text: After the floor drop the aircraft rebounds into the two PE hold-down pillars; they arrest it before the upper tube ends and foot pads close the 10 mm static gap to the bare lid shell, so the lid needs no lining
nodes.basis: EST: rebound at e = 0.5 from 2.43 m/s gives ~1.1 J on 2.05 kg; two 100 x 60 mm PE pillars ~0.23 m tall at ~40 kPa over 15 mm (5 preload + 10 gap) store ~3.6 J (3x). T-D7-BOX-DROP checks it: chalk on the upper motor caps, no mark on the lid
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Cradle crush column: stroke, load factor, free travel
nodes.equation: s_use = eps_use t ; n_T = 1 + h / (eta s_use) ; s_bottom = eps_bottom t ; travel_req = s_bottom + margin ; t_req = h / (eta (n_allow - 1) eps_use)

nodes.title: Box stack-up: height needed, clearances, drop allowed by the 0.50 m box

nodes.title: Box mass and loaded mass

nodes.title: Field set-up time, closed box to the arm check
nodes.equation: T = sum(step seconds) / 60

steps: open box: 2 cam straps, lift lid (pillars come with it); unfold the mat upwind, rubber up
lift aircraft by the centre section, stand it on its four feet on the mat; glance at the four replace-mark grooves
take props, pitot boom and pouch from the tray
fit 4 props, colour-matched to the motor (LH nut on the CW motors), 10 mm spanner
plug in the pitot boom, check the tubes, tip cover off
TX on (before the pack, flight card)
take a pack from the battery can, seat it at the trim mark, strap it
close the AS150U pack plug, FC boots

reasons: uses P:trn.setup_steps_s, which is UNVERIFIED (marked UNVERIFIED in redesign/subsystems/transport/params.json: time from the closed box to the start of the arm check (R-FIELD-SETUP). Round 3: mat unfold (C5 S1), foot groove glance (C5 S7) and TX-on-first (F5 CR-F5-09) added, +25 s. T-D7-SETUP replaces these)

nodes.title: Crush-column coupon test
nodes.procedure: Two 60 x 50 x 120 mm PE columns under a 2.05 kg dummy on a saddle; drop 0.3 m onto concrete, phone accelerometer on the dummy (>= 400 Hz app); 1.7 and 2.2 pcf; pick the lower peak

nodes.title: Loaded box drop
nodes.procedure: Ballasted spar-and-tube dummy with real feet first, then the aircraft. 0.3 m flat drop and one bottom-edge drop; then the off-axis faces at their CL-D7-*-DROP-ALLOW heights (end, front, aft, lid-down), dummy only; accelerometer taped on the spar at y 0; chalk on the motor caps, foot pads, pod nose and wingtips (no mark on floor, lid or walls except the pads)

nodes.title: Weigh the box empty and loaded, the mat, the battery can and the tote
nodes.procedure: 10 kg luggage scale, 3 readings each

nodes.title: Handle pull test
nodes.procedure: Loaded box hung from each handle in turn for 1 min, then jerked 3 times from 50 mm slack; no pull-through, no dent

nodes.title: Timed field set-up
nodes.procedure: CHECKLIST.md read aloud by one person, stopwatch by a second; three field days

nodes.title: Motor Kv 900 rpm/V
nodes.text: X3108S KV900 speed constant
nodes.basis: maker name and listing; the maker table's rpm at low throttle is consistent with it (CALC-E1-CAL residuals)

nodes.title: Winding resistance 86 mOhm at 25 degC
nodes.text: phase-to-phase resistance of the X3108S KV900
nodes.basis: two retailer listings agree (Robu, HiModel); measure with a 4-wire milliohm method on arrival
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: No-load current 0.9 A
nodes.text: no-load current, used as speed-independent iron + friction loss
nodes.basis: listing value at 10 V (~9 000 rpm), two listings agree: conservative below that speed
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: ESC loss 10 mOhm + 0.5 W
nodes.text: ESC conduction path 10 mOhm (two FETs + leads) and 0.5 W fixed
nodes.basis: typical BLHeli_S 45 A FETs 3-4 mOhm each; the fit factor kP absorbs any error at the calibration points

nodes.title: Pack + harness 24 mOhm, avionics 1 A
nodes.text: 4S 6500 130C pack 20 mOhm (5 mOhm/cell, part-aged) plus 4 mOhm main lead and connector; avionics + servos 1 A from the bus
nodes.basis: E2 measures pack IR with the charger; F1 owns the harness resistance
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Pack cells 20 mOhm, avionics 1 A
nodes.text: 4S 6500 130C pack, cells only: 4 x 5 mOhm (part-aged, 25 degC); avionics + servos 1 A from the bus. Harness from params electrical.r_ext_mohm
nodes.basis: E2's new-pack value is 4.0 mOhm/cell (ASM-E2-R-CELL); 5 mOhm/cell covers a season of cycling. E2 measures pack IR by load step (T-E2-IR)
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Pack OCV states
nodes.text: open-circuit pack voltage: full 4.20, mid 3.80, low 3.60 V/cell (4S)
nodes.basis: 3.60 V/cell OCV is the 20 % reserve point of a LiPo; the sag case uses it

nodes.title: Copper 0.393 %/K, hot winding 80 degC
nodes.text: R_m(T) = R_25 (1 + 0.00393 (T - 25)); thrust-limit cases use an 80 degC winding, current-limit cases 25 degC
nodes.basis: annealed copper coefficient; 80 degC = hot after a hover

nodes.title: PER3-to-measured factors transfer between APC 11 in props
nodes.text: kT, kP fitted on the 11x4.7SF apply to the 11x4.5MR / 11x5.5MR PER3 data
nodes.basis: same maker, same code, same diameter; H1's thrust stand (T-E1-STAND) measures the fitted prop directly and supersedes this
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Motor thermal resistance 1.0 K/W in own wash
nodes.text: steady winding-to-ambient resistance of the X3108S in its own static prop wash
nodes.basis: maker's 94 degC at the 30 A row, 25 degC room, losses from this model (CALC-E1-CAL); the test was not steady, so the true value may be higher: E3 owns the thermal model
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Pack-current limit 100 A
nodes.text: ArduPilot Q_M_BAT_CURR_MAX = 100 A (with the power module's current sensor calibrated) caps the summed motor current
nodes.basis: 4 x 25 A = the X3108S's 25 A / 30 s rating; F4 sets it, F1 sizes wiring to it

nodes.title: Transition thrust margin 1.3
nodes.text: full thrust at every point of the level pitch-over corridor >= 1.3 x the thrust that holds level unaccelerated flight there
nodes.basis: 0.3 g of surplus for acceleration and gusts; same headroom as ASM-A2-GUST-THRUST-HEADROOM

nodes.title: Wing CL: linear to CLmax, flat plate after stall
nodes.text: CL = a alpha up to CLmax (a = 2 pi AR/(AR+2)); above stall CN = 1.98 sin(alpha) (flat plate); prop wash on the wing ignored
nodes.basis: Hoerner flat-plate normal force; ignoring wash lift is conservative for thrust required; B1/B2 refine

nodes.title: Worst pack state for hover T/W
nodes.text: the lowest pack state the aircraft is flown in: the 20 % reserve line (E2 ASM-E2-OCV-20), pack cold-soaked to 10 degC (E2 ASM-E2-COLD-R), windings hot (80 degC, after a hover), 100 A limiter set; pack resistance = cells x R_cell x cold + R_ext (E2's model)
nodes.basis: one definition shared with E2 (CR-E2/E1 reconciliation 2026-11-09); the battery failsafe lands the aircraft at the reserve line, so states below it are emergencies, reported as a sensitivity (3.60 V/cell OCV)

nodes.title: Prop stack dimensions
nodes.text: motor body (mount face to bell top) 26.5 mm; bolt-on adapter base 6.35 mm, M6x1 post 15.2 mm above the base; prop hub 0.35 in = 8.89 mm; M6 washer 1.0 mm; M6 hex nut ISO 4032 5.2 mm
nodes.basis: HiModel listing (body), Small Parts CNC adapter drawing values, APC 11x5.5MR page (hub), ISO 4032 / ISO 7089 (nut, washer); measure the supplied adapter on arrival
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Motor screw length and engagement window
nodes.text: M3x8 SHCS (A2 stainless, same size as the old design's F01), no washer; thread engagement in the motor base 2.5-3.5 mm (>= 5 threads, tip clear of the stator). The plate and pad heights under the head are D3's (P:fin_detail.mount.*)
nodes.basis: X3108S base thread depth is not published: 3.5 mm is a conservative limit for a 31 mm stator base; probe the hole depth on arrival, the screw tip must stop >= 0.5 mm short of the bottom
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Per-unit flying masses incl. leads, g
nodes.text: motor with factory leads 81.0 (no bullets: harness HRN-E03); ESC stripped of its factory power leads (F2 solders its own 16 AWG to the pads, D-48, CR-F2-07) with signal lead and heat-shrink 7.6 (6.6 g bare board + 1.0 g; was 11.0 with 2 x 80 mm 16 AWG); prop 17.0; bolt-on adapter 3.0 + 4 x M3x4 1.2 + M6 nut 1.9 + washer 0.6 = 6.7; 4 x M3x8 SHCS motor screws 3.2
nodes.basis: listings (81 g, 17 g, 3.0 g); ISO masses for screws, nuts, washers; the stripped ESC is EST from the 6.6 g bare board (D-48, CR-A3-21: -3.4 g per ESC); weigh everything on arrival
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Fit PER3 to the maker's X3108S + 11x4.7 table
nodes.equation: kT = mean(T_meas / T_PER3(rpm)) ; kP: sum(P_bat,model(rpm) - P_meas) = 0 over rows 5-12 A ; R_th = (94 - 25) / P_loss(30 A row)

nodes.title: Hover operating point per motor, 11x4.5MR and 11x5.5MR
nodes.equation: T_m = m_gate g k_dl / (4 cos cant) ; solve rpm: T(rpm) = T_m ; I_bat, P_bat at V_bus = 14.8 V ; g/W = T_m / g / P_bat ; dT_wind = R_th P_loss

nodes.title: Full-throttle static thrust and current, all four motors
nodes.equation: duty = 1 ; V_bus = V_ocv - R_pack (4 I_bat + I_avn) ; T/W = 4 T_max / (m_gate g) ; cases: table basis (bus held 14.8 V, 25 degC), sag (OCV 14.4 V, R_pack, 80 degC), current limits (bus held 14.8 / 16.8 V, 25 degC)

nodes.title: Full throttle with the pack-current limiter Q_M_BAT_CURR_MAX
nodes.equation: largest duty with 4 I_bat + I_avn <= I_lim ; T/W = 4 T / (m_gate g) ; cases fresh (OCV 16.8 V, 25 degC) and low (OCV 14.4 V, 80 degC), with R_pack

nodes.title: Hover T/W at the worst pack state (E1 station model + E2 pack model)
nodes.equation: R_pack = cells R_cell k_cold + R_ext ; V_ocv = cells OCV ; largest duty with 4 I_bat + I_avn <= I_lim (station model, winding 80 degC) ; T/W = 4 T cos(cant) / (m_gate g) ; f_sag = T_worst / T_fresh (fresh: 4.20 V/cell, warm R, 25 degC)

nodes.title: Prop stack, prop-to-structure gap, nut and motor-screw engagement
nodes.equation: s = L_body + t_base + h_hub / 2 ; x_tip = L_body + t_base + L_post ; e_nut = L_post - h_hub - t_washer - h_nut ; gap = face_ahead + s >= 0.14 D (B4) ; e_screw = L_screw - t_plate (D3 R3: plate canted with the motor, uniform under every head)

nodes.title: Propulsion flying mass, four stations, per-unit masses incl. leads
nodes.equation: m = n (motor + ESC + prop + adapter and nut + motor screws)

nodes.title: Cruise point on B1's polar: four props share the drag
nodes.equation: CL = 2W/(rho V^2 S) ; D = q S (CD0 + k CL^2) trim (B1's as-designed polar, = CALC-B1V-CRUISE drag_gate_n) ; T_m = D / 4 ; solve rpm: T(rpm, J) = T_m ; eta_prop = T V / P_shaft ; eta_tot = T V / P_bat ; L/D_eff = W / D ; p_check = (P_55 + avionics) / B1 gate power

nodes.title: Thrust margin along the level pitch-over corridor (sag case, 11x4.5MR and 11x5.5MR)
nodes.equation: min over V in [0, V_tr] of 4 T_full(V cos a, OCV 14.4 V, 80 degC) / T_req,min(V) ; T_req from T sin a + L = W, T cos a >= D ; polar CL-B1V-CD0, CL-B1V-K, ASM-B1-TRIM (rev 8)

nodes.title: One motor out: what is left (11x5.5MR)
nodes.equation: hover: thrust/moment balance forces the diagonal partner to 0 -> 2 same-direction motors, T/W_2 = 2 T_max,worst / W, unbalanced yaw torque = 2 Q_hover ; cruise: 2 motors carry D, roll torque = 2 Q(T = D/2) for elevons to hold

nodes.title: Lower bound: pure PER3 power (kP = 1)
nodes.equation: as CALC-E1-HOVER and CALC-E1-CRUISE with kP = 1, kT = 1

nodes.title: Cruise electrical power, 11x5.5MR
nodes.how: Log pack power in steady 16 m/s FBWA legs, both directions, calm morning; subtract the avionics draw.
nodes.note: propulsion only (no avionics); drag from B1's as-designed polar (CL-B1V-CD0, CL-B1V-K, ASM-B1-TRIM; rev 8, D-67; was CL-B1-CD0 / CL-B1-K), CR-A1-32. p_check = (this + 6 W) / CL-B1V-CRUISE-P-GATE. The params limit is B1's pack power incl. 6 W avionics, so the comparison is 6 W conservative for B1. Rev 8 FAIL: 246.0 W > 240 (E1 + 6 W avionics = 252.0 W, p_check 1.055 against B1's 238.9 W at the gate): same drag (4.51 N), E1's eta_tot 0.293 from APC PER3 with kP 1.24 vs B1's chain. Band 200.2 (kP 1) - 246.0 W. D-13 carries the conservative one: CR-E1-51 asks A1 for cruise_power_w 252 (E2 re-runs) or cruise_ms 15 (213.9 + 6 = 220 W, 1.25 Vs at the gate)

nodes.title: Canted prop disc (-6 / +10 mm envelope) to the CF motor tube, true surface gap

nodes.note: rev 8 (D-61): on D3's 7.5 mm mount 26.1 mm, PASS (+1.1 mm); was 21.1 mm FAIL at 2.5 mm. D-52 (cant sense -1) swings the wing-side blade tip aft over the tube (42.8 mm with sense +1, gap_sense_plus_m). Same finding as D3's CR-D3-26 (20.9 mm at 2.5 mm). nodes.title: Thrust stand, one station, both candidate props

nodes.title: Incoming check: resistance, no-load current, mass, bolt pattern, hole and thread depth
nodes.procedure: Weigh motor, stripped ESC, prop, adapter set (0.1 g); calipers: base diameter (D3 needs >= 28 mm), base bolt pattern (D3 prints 16 x 19 mm), base hole depth (>= 4.0 mm, CL-E1-HOLE-DEPTH-MIN), bell-top thread length (>= 2.5 mm for D-58; >= 3.0 mm with >= 4.0 mm free depth -> M3x5, CR-A4-43), adapter flange under the screw head, motor phase-lead length from the base (F2's routed reach 0.121 m, CL-F2-PHASE-REACH: if the leads reach, no splice and F2 returns 12 g), ESC strapped on a printed pad (height proud), body length, adapter base and post; on the first built station a printed 25 mm gauge between the blade's aft face at the tip and the CF tube, blade turned through the wing-side position (R-PROP-CLEAR); 4-wire: 2.00 A from a bench supply through two phases, read the voltage drop (R = V / I); no-load current and rpm at 10.0 V without prop (Kv = rpm / (V - I0 R))

nodes.basis: R-TEST-ORDER transition at >= 50 m AGL; ArduPilot Q_PILOT_SPD_UP default 2.5 m/s, land 1 m/s; tailsitter pitch-over is a few seconds at high throttle (J1 evidence); doubled for the pessimistic case

nodes.title: Cruise mass scaling, circuit factor and independent cross-check model
nodes.text: The cruise power LEVEL is B1's as-designed simulation (CL-B1V-CRUISE-P-GATE at the 2.6 kg gate; CL-B1V-CRUISE-P-PESS at A3's predicted mass CL-A3-MASS-PREDICTED; level flight, avionics included). This E2 drag model (CD0 0.0593, x1.3 pessimistic, e from params, eta_prop 0.47 / 0.35, eta_motor 0.72, trim 1.05) only scales B1's power from B1's reference mass to the budget mass (the pessimistic value up to the gate), and is reported as a cross-check. The turning (circuit) factor 1.05 multiplies B1's level-flight power
nodes.basis: K09 sizing.json CD0 build-up; REVIEW section 4 corrected efficiencies; circuits inside one RFS sub-field spend about half the time in 30 deg banks (induced drag x1.33). CR-E2-08: B1 owns cruise power; E2 follows B1's claims through the proof chain (re-run this script after every B1 re-run)
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Charge profile
nodes.text: CC at min(1C, charger W / 16.8 V) to ~85 % state of charge, then CV for 20 min
nodes.basis: standard LiPo CC-CV; 1C is the maker's normal charge rate for hobby packs

nodes.title: Energy budget per phase, base case (sized mass)
nodes.equation: I = (Voc - sqrt(Voc^2 - 4 R P)) / (2 R) per phase ; Ah = I t ; P_cruise = P_B1(gate) x circuit x P_E2(m) / P_E2(gate) ; t_cruise = (C - 0.2 C - sum Ah_fixed) / I_cruise

nodes.title: Energy budget per phase, pessimistic (2.6 kg gate)
nodes.equation: as base, with m = gate, C x 0.92, R x 1.5 (10 degC), P_hover x 1.10, P_cruise = B1 as-designed pessimistic (CL-B1V-CRUISE-P-PESS at A3 predicted mass) x P_E2,pess(gate) / P_E2,pess(m_pred) x circuit, 20 s transitions

nodes.title: Bus voltage at the 100 A limiter vs pack state; bracket on the thrust factor
nodes.equation: V_bus = Voc - R I_lim (limiter binds when I_unlim(V) = n I_148 (V/14.8)^2 > I_lim) ; thrust factor worst/fresh bracketed by (V_w/V_f) (thrust prop. to power) and (V_w/V_f)^(2/3) (ideal rotor at fixed current) ; old rule (V/V_tab)^2 kept for the record (unlimited motor) ; bracket margin = min(f_E1 - lower, upper - f_E1)

nodes.title: Pack self-heating over the pessimistic mission, cold and hot mornings
nodes.equation: Q = sum(I^2 R t) over phases ; dT = Q / (m c) (adiabatic, c = 1000 J/kg K) ; T_end = T_amb + dT ; cold: 10 degC, R x 1.5 ; hot: 30 degC, R x 1.0

nodes.title: Pack trade: candidates against the gate and the pessimistic mission
nodes.equation: m = m_sized - m_pack_baseline + m_cand ; pessimistic at m + (gate - m_sized) ; pass = m <= gate AND t_cruise_pess >= 5 min AND I_cont >= I_full

nodes.title: E1's worst/fresh thrust factor lies inside E2's physical bracket (D-35)
nodes.how: T-E1-STAND fresh and worst-state runs: measured thrust ratio between the measured bus-voltage ratio and its 2/3 power.
nodes.note: D-35 resolved: E2 adopts E1's station model (CL-E1-SAG-FACTOR, CL-E1-TW-WORST) as the one worst-state claim. The limiter binds in every pack state, so the pack current is fixed at 100 A and thrust follows power (lower bound, thrust ~ V) or the ideal rotor (upper, ~ V^(2/3)); E1 lies between. Retires CL-E2-SAG-F-WORST and CL-E2-TW-SAG-WORST (the (V/14.8)^2 rule counted the sag twice)

nodes.title: Flight pack mass carried in the budget (not yet weighed)
nodes.how: Weigh each pack on arrival on a 1 g scale (T-E2-WEIGH) and enter it in pack_log.csv, then re-run. Pass: every pack <= CL-E2-PACK-ACCEPT-KG (= CL-A1-PACK-ACCEPT, 0.5926 kg today); a pack above 0.556 kg (the listed maximum) is reported to A3 so the 550 g line is replaced; a pack above the acceptance line is returned (D-64; the Tattu fallback is not pre-approved).

nodes.title: Weigh and measure every pack on arrival
nodes.procedure: 1 g scale; calipers L x W x H incl. lead exit; one row per pack (E2-P1, E2-P2) in redesign/team/E2/pack_log.csv, then re-run this script and build_graph.py.

nodes.title: Discharge capacity test at 1C
nodes.procedure: Charger discharge mode is limited in power: discharge through the thrust stand at ~6.5 A to 3.5 V/cell under load, log mAh with the watt meter; pass >= 6.0 Ah (R-PACK-MASS).

nodes.title: Pack resistance by load step
nodes.procedure: Thrust stand, one motor: rest voltage, then 20 A step; R = dV / dI after 2 s; repeat at 10 degC (pack 1 h in a fridge, bagged). Pass <= 5 mOhm/cell at 25 degC.

nodes.title: Full-mission current log
nodes.procedure: DataFlash BAT messages; IR thermometer on pack before/after; compare row by row with the phase table.

nodes.title: Air properties at 300 K
nodes.text: kinematic viscosity, conductivity, Prandtl number used in every film coefficient

nodes.title: Motor specific heat 540 J/kg K
nodes.text: one lumped node of 81 g: copper ~20 g, laminations ~25 g, aluminium bell and base ~20 g, magnets and shaft ~16 g
nodes.basis: mass-weighted c_p (Cu 385, Fe 450, Al 900, NdFeB 440, steel 470) = 520-560

nodes.title: Motor thermal resistance 1.5 K/W (design)
nodes.text: winding-to-ambient resistance in its own prop wash used for the design case; E1's 1.0 K/W is the nominal case

reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: ESC body 45 x 20 x 6 mm, 11 g, 700 J/kg K
nodes.text: LANRC 45 A in heat-shrink, strapped flat on the fin pad, FET side out; the pad face is adiabatic (foam board); the leads' fin effect is ignored (conservative)
nodes.basis: typical 45 A BLHeli_S 2-6S board size (LANRC publishes no drawing; propulsion_detail.esc.size_m); mass 7.6 g stripped (D-48: 6.6 g bare board + 1.0 g signal lead and shrink, A3 overrides.csv PRP-002; was 11 g with factory leads); c_p FR4 + copper + parts. Measure on arrival
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: ESC pad centre at x 0.101 m, 0.072 m from the motor axis (D3 layout)
nodes.text: pad FIN-007 on the half-fin face from x 0.078 to 0.124 m, centre |z| 0.118 m (72 mm toward the wing from the motor axis), ESC long side along x; the 20 mm wide ESC spans 62-82 mm from the axis
nodes.basis: subsystems/fins/params.json fin_detail.esc_pad (x0 0.078, len 0.046, z 0.118; D3 R2, CL-D3-ESC-WASH), which replaces E3's R1 proposal (x 0.10, 60 mm). Inside the contracted slipstream, clear of the hub wake (r < 30 mm)

nodes.title: Hook-and-loop strap covers 320 mm2 of the ESC's exposed faces
nodes.text: one 10 mm strap through the two pad slots wraps the ESC once: it covers 10 mm x (20 + 2 x 6) mm of the FET face and sides, which then reject no heat (conservative)
nodes.basis: fins BUILD.md / params fin_detail.esc_pad.slot_m (10 mm strap); ESC 45 x 20 x 6 (ASM-E3-ESC): exposed 1 680 mm2 -> 1 360 mm2 (-19 %)

nodes.title: Local-velocity factor at the ESC 0.7 nominal / 0.5 design
nodes.text: velocity over the ESC = factor x the slipstream (hover) or free-stream (cruise) velocity, for the motor-tube wake and the fin boundary layer
nodes.basis: the pad is 2.5 tube diameters behind the 22 mm tube, on its wake centreline; a cylinder wake keeps a 0.3-0.5 velocity deficit there; the 6 mm ESC sits inside a 3-6 mm fin boundary layer. Measure with a hot-wire or the ESC temperature on the stand (T-E3-ESC-PAD)
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Emissivity 0.9, still-air film 8 W/m2 K
nodes.text: heat-shrink, solder mask, anodised and painted surfaces; natural convection on small parts with no flow
nodes.basis: Incropera Table 1.1 (free convection, gases 2-25); radiation linearised at the part temperature

nodes.title: Pack c_p 1 000 J/kg K, cell R 5 mOhm design, R(T) x 1.5 per 15 K below 25 degC
nodes.text: pack heat = I^2 x cells x R_cell(T); R_cell = 4 mOhm nominal (E2), 5 mOhm design (E2's T-E2-IR acceptance limit); R(T) = R25 x 1.5^((25 - T)/15) below 25 degC, R25 above (no credit for warm cells)
nodes.basis: E2 ASM-E2-R-CELL, ASM-E2-COLD-R and T-E2-IR pass value; c_p as E2 (LiPo 1 000-1 100)
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Flight controller top board 52 x 32 mm, 15 J/K; the R2 2.0 W lumped value is kept as the bound
nodes.text: FC node = CoreWing F405 Wing APP V2 top board + wireless board alone, on four 5 mm gel cubes, both faces exchange with the pod air; its dissipation now comes from F3 (CALC-E3-* read ASM-F3-5V-LOADS); the 5 V regulator sits on the separated power board PWR-003
nodes.basis: subsystems/avionics/params.json fc_board_m [0.052, 0.032] and fc_mass_g 12 (c ~ 1 000 J/kg K + gel and strap -> 15 J/K); F3-R2 split of the stack (CR-F3-13). Index 0 is the R2 bound (2.0 W total, F3's limit line for CL-F3-FC-DISS)
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Other pod heat: power-board regulator + idle from F3, UBEC 0.8 W, design factor 1.25
nodes.text: heat released straight into the pod air by the CoreWing power board PWR-003 (5 V regulator losses and servo-BEC idle: CL-F3-FC-DISS minus the FC's own 5 V x (FC + wireless) load) and by the servo UBEC PWR-005 (right channel); every pod source (FC, power board, UBEC) is multiplied by the design factor until T-F3-5V runs
nodes.basis: UBEC: two elevon servos, mean 0.3-0.5 A at 6.0 V in gusty flight = 1.8-3.0 W out, eta 0.80 -> 0.45-0.75 W; 0.8 W carried. Factor 1.25 for unmeasured loads (F3 5 V budget is EST)
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Harness resistance inside the pod 2.9 mOhm
nodes.text: of F1's 6.5 mOhm pack-to-ESC path only the common path (pack leads, AS150U, bus board, fuse) is inside the pod; the four 14.5 mOhm ESC branches (3.6 mOhm equivalent) run in the wing and fins and their heat leaves there
nodes.basis: params electrical.r_ext_mohm note (D-32): 'common path 2.9 + four 14.5 branches in parallel'. R2 put E2's old 3 mOhm all in the pod; reading the new 6.5 mOhm whole would double-count 3.6 mOhm of wing wiring
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Power scaling from the 2.6 kg gate to the as-designed mass
nodes.text: hover, climb, transitions and descent: P ~ m^1.5 (momentum theory, constant figure of merit); cruise: P ~ m^1.0 (about half the cruise drag is induced at 16 m/s, so dP/P = 2 x 0.5 x dm/m); currents scale with power; cruise time re-solved so the mission still ends on E2's 20 % line (same energy as the gate table)
nodes.basis: E2 ASM-E2-CRUISE-AERO scales B1's level-flight power with mass the same way; induced share 0.4-0.6 at CL 0.37 (B1)

nodes.title: CF motor tube as a cooling fin below the mount
nodes.text: 22 x 20 mm CF tube, axial conductivity 5 W/m K (quasi-isotropic layup, fibre share along the axis), outer surface in the slipstream at the CFD film coefficient, inside still; root at the mount temperature (taken = motor peak, conservative); PETG station collar 30 mm below
nodes.basis: CF/epoxy tubes 3-10 W/m K along the axis (roll-wrapped); collar distance subsystems/fins/params.json station_collar note ('30 mm below the motor plate')
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Pod shell and vents
nodes.text: shell foam board 5 mm, k 0.035 W/m K, the face on the wing adiabatic; pod air 10 J/K; recommended vents: inlet 15 x 30 mm at the pod nose and an equal exit at the rear, internal velocity 0.25 x airspeed in cruise, no vent flow credited in hover
nodes.basis: foam board k 0.03-0.04; vent sizing as the previous design (docs/research/thermal.md 6.4); 0.25 for inlet and internal losses EST

nodes.title: Mission order and hover split
nodes.text: chronological order of E2's phases: ground, climb, first hover (half of the hover row), forward transition, cruise, back-transition, second hover, descent; motors off on the ground; climb, hover, transitions and descent use the static prop law; the abuse case adds 30 s at the 100 A limiter after the first hover
nodes.basis: mission profile params.json#mission.profile; E2 ASM-E2-PROFILE; E1 CR-E1-10 (full throttle <= 30 s)

nodes.title: Temperature limits
nodes.text: motor winding/stator 80; PETG mount HDT 68; ASA mount HDT 93; ESC 85; pack 60 rating and 50 at landing for life; FC 85 degC
nodes.basis: motor: previous test-plan abort value (SunnySky publishes none; the maker's own test reached 94 degC); PETG and ASA: TDS HDT at 0.45 MPa; ESC: EFM8BB21 G-grade MCU; pack: hobby LiPo rating (E2 uses 50 at landing); FC: STM32F405 and IMU rating
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Morning sun 700 W/m2, absorptivity 0.9 dark / 0.3 white, outside film 20 W/m2 K, 600 s soak
nodes.text: parked aircraft at set-up, sun on the pod top
nodes.basis: clear April morning 09-10 h; Incropera Table 1.1; five-minute set-up plus waiting
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Ambient sweep 15, 20, 25, 30 degC
nodes.text: field ambients at which every temperature is reported for the mission table; the pack starts at ambient (E2's >= 20 degC warm-up rule is not modelled, so the 15 degC row is a cold-pack row)
nodes.basis: E3 task scope 2026-11-09 (15-30 degC); params env.ambient_design_c is [10, 30] and its cold end stays in CL-E3-PACK-RISE-COLD

nodes.title: H1 GT-04 stand sequence
nodes.text: one station on the stand with the ESC on the half-fin mock-up: 120 s at 690 gf hover thrust, 10 s at the 25 A limiter share, 60 s at hover thrust, then stop; no forward flow
nodes.basis: team/H1/GROUND-TEST-PLAN.md GT-04 step 1 (CR-H1-06)

nodes.title: Mission temperatures at the top of the design ambient (30 degC)
nodes.equation: per node C dT/dt = Q(t, T) - sum G (T - T_neighbour) ; Q_motor = I_m^2 R_m(T) + I0 n/Kv, Q_esc = I_m^2 R_esc + P_fix with I_m from P_bus = I_m (n/Kv + I_m R_m) + Q_esc and Q = kP Q_B4 (n/n_B4)^2 ; ESC h = 0.664 Re^0.5 Pr^1/3 k/L at f_wake v(x), v(x) = v_i (1 + x/sqrt(x^2+R^2)) + 4 eps sigma T^3 ; pack Q = I^2 N R_cell(T) ; explicit Euler dt 0.5 s, pod air relaxed exactly

nodes.title: Field-ambient ceiling per part (design case, mission and hover-only sortie)
nodes.equation: T_amb,max(part) = max T_amb such that peak T_part(T_amb) <= limit (bisection on the full model) ; ceiling = min over parts ; pack starts at ambient

nodes.title: Model checks: time-step convergence, steady hover vs hand value, pack vs E2
nodes.equation: convergence: peaks at dt 1.0 / 0.5 / 0.25 s ; steady: T_mot - T_amb -> Q_m R_th after 15 tau ; pack: adiabatic, R x 1.0 at 30 degC and x 1.5 at 10 degC, E2 phase order -> E2's dT

nodes.title: Pre-flight sun soak of the pack in the pod
nodes.equation: T_sol-air - T_amb = alpha G / h_o ; Q = G_top (T_sa - T_amb), G_top = A_top / (t/k + 1/h_o) ; dT_pack <= Q t / (m c) (all of it reaching the pack: upper bound)

nodes.title: Operating limits: full-throttle burst length and pack start temperature (design, 30 degC)
nodes.equation: burst: max t such that peak T_motor <= 80 degC and T_esc <= 85 degC with t s at the limiter after the first hover ; pack: max T_start such that T_pack(landing) <= 50 degC (bisection)

nodes.title: Mission temperatures across the 15-30 degC field ambient (design and nominal)
nodes.equation: as CALC-E3-MISSION, repeated at each ambient of ASM-E3-AMB-SWEEP ; rows [T_amb, motor peak, ESC peak, pack at landing, FC peak, pod-air peak] in degC

nodes.title: Predicted rises for the H1 GT-04 stand sequence (CR-H1-06)
nodes.equation: rpm from thrust n = n_B4 sqrt(T / (kT T_B4)) ; bus power from the motor model at 25 degC ; RC network of CALC-E3-MISSION with the static slipstream, sequence ASM-E3-GT04 ; rise = T - T_amb at stop (what the IR reads) ; scaled-to-30 degC = T_meas - T_amb,test + 30

nodes.title: CF motor tube as a fin: temperature at the PETG station collar (design, 30 degC)
nodes.equation: T(x) - T_amb = (T_root - T_amb) cosh(m (L - x)) / cosh(m L) -> long fin: theta(x)/theta_0 = exp(-m x), m = sqrt(h P / (k A)), P = pi D_o, A = pi (D_o^2 - D_i^2) / 4 ; h = CFD film at the design hover slipstream ; root at the motor peak

nodes.title: Motor thermal resistance and time constant on the thrust stand
nodes.procedure: One station on the H1 stand with the real printed mount, 11x5.5MR, 14.8 V. K-type thermocouples on the stator (through the base vent), between base and mount, and on the bell (IR). From ambient: hover power (~100 W bus) for 10 min, log every 5 s; fit T = T_inf - (T_inf - T_0) e^(-t/tau): R_th = (T_inf - T_amb) / loss, loss = P_in - torque x omega. Then 30 s at 24.8 A. Pass: R_th <= 1.5 K/W, base < 83 degC (ASA) at hover power from 30 degC; tube at the station collar < 58 degC (PETG).

nodes.title: ESC on a fin-pad mock-up in the slipstream
nodes.procedure: Foam-board half-fin with a 22 mm tube LE behind the stand prop; ESC strapped on the pad at x 0.101 m, 0.072 m from the axis, FET side out; thermocouple under the heat-shrink on the FETs. Hover power 10 min, then 30 s at the limiter. Tuft on the pad. Back-solve the wake factor: f = (h_meas / h_model)^2. Pass: <= 70 degC steady at hover power from 30 degC (15 K below the MCU rating).

nodes.title: Temperatures after the first full missions
nodes.procedure: Field ambient from the handheld anemometer/thermometer at take-off; IR on the four motor cans, ESCs and the pack within 60 s of landing; IMU.T and BAT current from the log. Compare with the model re-run at the measured ambient: within +-8 K, else update ASM-E3-RTH-DESIGN / ASM-E3-WAKE.

nodes.text: [name, length m, cooling factor] for sections where more than one pair shares a passage
nodes.basis: F2: LR/LL pairs together through the P1 straw (~0.05 m) and two twisted pairs stacked 8 mm in the pod crossing (~0.09 m). Factor = fraction of free-air convection + radiation kept: straw enclosed in foam 0.3 (four conductors, little radiation out), pod crossing 0.6 (twisted 0.85 x stacked ~0.7). Judgement, conservative; T-F1-WIRE-HEAT checks the straw
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Silicone wire outside diameter by gauge
nodes.text: [AWG, OD mm] for high-strand silicone hobby wire
nodes.basis: typical maker tables (BNTECHGO, Turnigy) +/-0.2 mm; measure the reel
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Cooling derates
nodes.text: [f_pod, f_channel, f_pair, emissivity]: f_pod 1.0 in the vented pod (still air); f_channel 0.75 for a lead in a tape-covered surface groove in the wing; f_pair 0.85 for a twisted +/- pair (pod only; in the wing + and - lie in two grooves 5 mm apart, f 1.0); silicone emissivity 0.9
nodes.basis: engineering judgement: a covered groove halves convection but keeps radiation to the tape and foam (~0.75 overall); a twisted pair shields ~15 % of each conductor's surface. Prop wash over the wing in hover is not credited. T-F1-WIRE-HEAT measures it
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Contact resistance per mated contact
nodes.text: AS150U contact 0.8 mOhm (two in the path)
nodes.basis: reseller values 0.40 and <= 0.8 mOhm; the larger is used
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Current shunt, board copper and solder joints

reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Servo stall current 1.4 A at 6 V

nodes.title: XT30U in each ESC branch (D-74, WB-03)

nodes.title: Board-to-board link (W-PMOD, case S): 28 AWG conductors per role
nodes.text: [FC-BEC 5 V, SERVO-BEC Vx, GND] conductors in parallel; BATT_VOLT and BATT_CURR one each (10 wired). Vx gets 4 (all four SERVO-BEC contacts) so the servo terminal voltage holds 5.7 V (F2 CL-F2-SERVO-V)

nodes.title: Bus capacitance per ESC 1 000 uF

nodes.title: Pessimistic mission current profile from E2's phase claims

nodes.title: Design currents for the pack path

nodes.title: Wire derating: steady rise, mission-profile peak, drop, mass

nodes.title: Wire heat runs
nodes.procedure: Bench supply (>= 40 A) + load; built power stack (10 AWG jumpers) in a closed pod mock-up at 30 A, 16 AWG pair in a taped XPS groove at 8.4 A, two pairs through a 50 mm straw at 8.4 A each, each 10 min; K-type thermocouples mid-lead under foam tape; then 50 A for 2 s on the 16 AWG. Pass: rise <= 10 degC steady (jumpers: above their joints), <= 30 degC peak, pack leads <= 20 degC.

nodes.title: AS150U heat run
nodes.procedure: 38 A for 10 min through a mated pair; IR thermometer on the housing; rise <= 30 degC.

nodes.title: Path resistance
nodes.procedure: 20 A load step from the pack; meter across pack terminals and across one ESC's pads; R = dV/dI. Pass: drop <= 2 % at 30 A.

nodes.title: Current sensor calibration
nodes.procedure: Clamp meter on the main lead at 5, 15, 25, 30 A (motors on the restrained frame); set BATT_AMP_PERVLT so BAT.Curr is within 5 %; record the value for F4.

nodes.title: Servo stall current and rail voltage
nodes.procedure: Each servo blocked at full deflection 2 s on the power-board servo BEC (6 V jumper), meter in series; both together: Vx >= 5.8 V at the servo and FC 5 V rail >= 4.8 V (as BOARD-CHECK.md step 7, with the real servos).

nodes.title: Anti-spark behaviour
nodes.procedure: Scope on the bus while plugging the AS150U slowly; bus >= 95 % before the main pins close; no spark marks after 20 plug cycles.

nodes.title: ESC supply ripple
nodes.procedure: Scope at each ESC's pads, full-throttle 2 s punch on the stand: ripple <= 1.0 V p-p, no spikes above 21 V (ESC caps 25 V).

nodes.title: Routed cut lengths per wire (path x helix + service loop)
nodes.equation: L_cut = sum(seg x helix(OD, lay) if twisted) + loop; helix = sqrt(1 + (pi OD / lay)^2)

nodes.title: Calibrated thrust-cell U95 = 0.5 % of the 2.5 kgf calibration span
nodes.text: After T-H1-STAND-CAL the thrust reading is within 0.5 % of the 2.5 kgf dead-weight span (12.5 gf) anywhere in that span, including drift between the start and end calibration.
nodes.basis: GT-01 pass lines: linearity <= 0.5 % FS and start/end drift <= 0.5 %

nodes.title: Thrust-cell calibration span 2.5 kgf
nodes.text: Dead weights 0.5/1.0/2.0/2.5 kg on the thrust axis (GT-01 step 2); the top weight covers 1.25 x the 21.1 N limit thrust (2.69 kgf) within 7 %.
nodes.basis: largest water-jug/dead-weight set that can be hung on the axle cord safely

nodes.title: Mount-stiffness rig: optical lever and load steps
nodes.text: T-C4-MOUNT-STIFF read by a laser pointer reflected off a 10 mm mirror bonded to the motor can, onto mm paper on a wall L = 5.0 m away (spot moves 2 theta L); a second mirror on the collar subtracts tube and stub rotation. Spot centre read to +/-0.3 mm from a tripod phone photo against a 1 mm grid. Loads 0.5, 1.0, 1.5 kg at the prop nut. For comparison, C4's two dial gauges (0.01 mm) are 0.030 m apart.
nodes.basis: optical lever is the standard way to read sub-milliradian rotations without a fine gauge; R3: wall 3.0 -> 5.0 m (a corridor) and photo read-out, because C4's need rose to ~1 970 N m/rad (15:01 re-publish) and the spot shrinks with it; laser pointer and mirror are team-owned

nodes.title: Coupon lever frame 15:1 / 9:1, water jugs to 20 kg
nodes.text: 2x4 (38 x 89 mm) lever 1.0 m long on an M8 pivot; coupon clevis at 0.060 m (15:1) or 0.100 m (9:1) from the pivot, jug hook at 0.900 m. Pivot and both clevis holes in a pair of 3 mm steel side plates 40 x 200 mm, each plate held to the lever by 4 x M6 through-bolts; lever tare balanced by a counterweight on the short side. nodes.basis: CR-C6-39 asks >= 2 660 N for the strip anchor; 15:1 x 20 kg = 2 940 N. The 9:1 hole keeps resolution for the 40-300 N coupons. Steel plates because bare wood across the grain does not carry the pivot bearing (CALC-H1-LEVER)

nodes.title: Strain-gauge read-out: half bridge (active + dummy) on an HX711 at reduced excitation
nodes.text: 350 ohm foil gauges, gauge factor 2.0 +/-1 %, grid 3 x 2.5 mm (I1 G13). Each active gauge is paired with a dummy gauge bonded on an unloaded offcut of the same material beside the article (temperature compensation), completed by two 350 ohm 0.1 % resistors; one HX711 per bridge (G06 and G12 boards), channel A gain 128. The HX711's 4.3 V excitation is dropped to the bridge through 1.5 kohm in each lead (self-heating on paper over foam). Noise 0.1 uV rms after averaging (2 x the datasheet's 50 nV at 10 SPS for the leads). Shunt calibration: 100 kohm across the dummy arm.
nodes.basis: Vishay TN-502 self-heating guidance: <= 0.05 W/in2 (78 W/m2) on poor heat sinks such as plastics and foam laminates; a dummy gauge on the same substrate cancels apparent strain

D-31 corrects D-22: the stroke does cost box height, because the tube ends and feet sink with the aircraft (box 0.54 m). The aft-wall drop is taken by the four feet (0.25 m, CL-D7-AFT-N); end, nose and lid-down drops are label-and-test only (0.06-0.09 m): the box carries 'keep upright' (54-57 mm of end/side stroke would need ~0.2 m more box). The 5 deg cant option (CR-B4-14, 25.5 mm) stays the fallback after T-B4-YAW. D-51 carried -0.0077 (face_ahead 2.5 mm, mid-plane 27.3 mm to the tube face, which ignored the aft blade); D-28 -0.0082

nodes.title: propulsion.stations.cant_deg
nodes.note: CHANGE-LOG D-27: was 3 (D-09). Tangential cant about the line from the x-axis to the motor so the thrust side component turns the airframe like the reaction torque (same sense as the 3 deg prints: UR and LL print A, UL and LR print B, D3 CR-D3-07; F4 CL-F4-CANT-NET-FORCE 0). B3 at R1: 3 deg gives hover yaw 1.15 x the 5 m/s disturbance and 1.15 rad/s2 against 1.5 x and 2 rad/s2 (R-HOVER-AUTHORITY, 30 % differential cap); 6.1 deg needed, 7 deg gives 2.23 x and 2.24 rad/s2 for 0.75 % thrust (CL-B3-HOVER-CANT-REQ). B4 re-runs swirl recovery at 7 deg; C4/C6 re-check the mount for the 12 % side component; the mount angle is one print parameter (fin_detail.mount). CHANGE-LOG D-52 (F4 CR-F4-11, B4 CR-B4-15a, E1 CR-E1-32): the sense as printed in D3's R3 CAD is REVERSED (side force opposes the reaction torque; hover yaw would reverse): D3 sets fin_detail.mount.cant_sense_UR = -1, i.e. the UR prop end leans toward the wing and outboard (side component along -t = (0, +0.511, -0.860)), same rule at every station; H1/H2 verify by inclinometer and a hanging yaw test before the first hover (CR-B4-16b). B4's 5 deg option (CR-B4-14: 1.03 x with no fin credit, +4.3 mm blade-to-tube gap) is kept open until T-B4-YAW; 7 deg stays (B4 at 7 deg: yaw 1.30 x with no fin credit, 2.23-3.15 x with the fin)

nodes.title: fin_detail.fin.root_fillet.gcc

nodes.title: trn.box.external_m
nodes.note: L (y) x W (x) x H (z). Length and width are A1's D-16 values; height 0.54 (was 0.50) because the lower tube ends need free travel equal to the cradle crush stroke (CL-D7-BOX-H-REQ). Freeze only after CAR-FIT.md has two measured cars

nodes.title: trn.box.lid_lining_t_m
nodes.note: D-31 round 2: no full lid lining (was 6 mm PE). It only protected the upper tube ends and foot pads, and the hold-down pillars stop the rebound well before they reach the lid (ASM-D7-REBOUND). Lid stack = 4 mm shell; +6 mm drop travel

nodes.title: trn.box.lid_lip_m

nodes.title: trn.box.end_pad_size_m
nodes.note: x by z, centred on the wing chord at the tip

nodes.title: trn.box.strap_y_m

nodes.title: trn.box.fallback_height_m

nodes.title: trn.box.aft_gap_m
nodes.note: round 3 (C1 CR-C1-22): the aircraft sits 12 mm off the aft wall (foot pads, x 0.368) instead of centred; the four crushable feet take an aft-wall-first drop along their own stroke axis (CALC-D7-OFFAXIS). The slack moves to the nose side

nodes.title: trn.box.nose_pad_t_m
nodes.note: round 4 (D-47/D-53 forward): 3/4 in PE plank on the front wall facing the pod nose (was 1 in). With the nose at -0.130 (envelope x 0.498) the 1 in pad left 6.6 mm < 10 mm; 3/4 in leaves 12.95 mm (CL-D7-NOSE-GAP). Box W stays 0.55 (A1 D-16). Costs nose-first drop height 0.079 -> 0.059 m (label-and-test case, KEEP UPRIGHT)

nodes.title: trn.box.nose_pad_size_m
nodes.note: y by z, centred on the pod nose (y 0, z +0.05); 0.2 m tall so the nose still faces it after the 72 mm floor-drop sink. Round 4: antenna tube B ends <= 10 mm ahead of the nose (CR-D7-13) and so stops 2.9 mm short of the pad (CL-D7-ANTENNA-PAD-GAP); a 12 mm wide vertical relief slot (antenna z +6 mm down 90 mm, covers the 72 mm sink) is kept as margin

nodes.title: trn.setup_steps_s
value: open box: 2 cam straps, lift lid (pillars come with it); unfold the mat upwind, rubber up
lift aircraft by the centre section, stand it on its four feet on the mat; glance at the four replace-mark grooves
take props, pitot boom and pouch from the tray
fit 4 props, colour-matched to the motor (LH nut on the CW motors), 10 mm spanner
plug in the pitot boom, check the tubes, tip cover off
TX on (before the pack, flight card)
take a pack from the battery can, seat it at the trim mark, strap it
close the AS150U pack plug, FC boots
